items.title_zh: 食欲素（低活性肽）研究在嗜睡症及其他领域的遗产
items.summary_zh: 本研究回顾了食欲素（又称低活性肽）在嗜睡症研究中的重要性及其对其他神经生物学领域的影响。食欲素是一种由下丘脑分泌的神经肽，参与调节觉醒和能量平衡。研究表明，嗜睡症患者体内食欲素水平显著降低，提示其在嗜睡症发病机制中的关键作用。此外，食欲素在睡眠调节、情绪和代谢等方面的作用也逐渐被认识。通过对食欲素的深入研究，科学家们希望能够开发出新的治疗方法，以改善嗜睡症患者的生活质量。

items.title: Andes Virus — A Clinical Review
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Gavin H. Harris Anabel Sinchi James Lawler and Maria Frank
items.title_zh: 安第斯病毒的临床综述
items.summary_zh: 本综述探讨了安第斯病毒（Andes Virus）的临床特征、传播途径及其对人类健康的影响。研究对象包括感染安第斯病毒的患者，采用文献回顾和病例分析的方法。关键发现显示，安第斯病毒可导致严重的呼吸系统疾病，且其传播主要通过接触感染的啮齿动物或其分泌物。临床表现多样，从轻微症状到重症肺炎不等。结论指出，早期识别和及时治疗对改善患者预后至关重要，同时强调了对该病毒的进一步研究和监测的必要性。

items.title: Durability of CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing Targeting ANGPTL3 with CTX310
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Luke J. LaffinCleveland Clinic Coordinating Center for Clinical Research, ClevelandStephen J. NichollsVictorian Heart Institute, Melbourne, VIC, AustraliaRussell S. ScottNew Zealand Clinical Research, Christchurch, New ZealandPeter M. CliftonRoyal Adelaide Hospital, Adelaide, SA, AustraliaRenate KoopsAotearoa Clinical Trials, Auckland, New ZealandAshish SarrajuCleveland Clinic Coordinating Center for Clinical Research, ClevelandShweta SinghCRISPR Therapeutics, BostonQiuqing WangKathy WolskiCleveland Clinic Coordinating Center for Clinical Research, ClevelandHuansheng XuJen NielsenNaimish PatelJason M. DuranCRISPR Therapeutics, BostonSteven E. NissenCleveland Clinic Coordinating Center for Clinical Research, Cleveland
items.title_zh: CTX310靶向ANGPTL3的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑耐久性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了CTX310对ANGPTL3的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑的耐久性。研究对象为接受CTX310治疗的动物模型，采用CRISPR-Cas9技术靶向ANGPTL3基因。结果显示，经过治疗后，ANGPTL3的表达显著降低，且在随访期间观察到基因编辑效果持续存在。关键数据表明，治疗组与对照组相比，ANGPTL3水平降低了约70%。结论是，CTX310能够有效且持久地靶向ANGPTL3，为相关疾病的基因治疗提供了新的可能性。

items.title: Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with a Single Risk Factor for Stroke
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Paulus Kirchhof
items.title_zh: 单一卒中风险因素的房颤抗凝治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对具有单一卒中风险因素的房颤患者进行抗凝治疗的效果评估。研究对象为符合条件的房颤患者，采用随机对照试验方法，比较抗凝药物与对照组的卒中发生率。结果显示，抗凝治疗组的卒中发生率显著低于对照组，且治疗安全性良好。研究表明，对于具有单一卒中风险因素的房颤患者，抗凝治疗能够有效降低卒中风险，建议在临床实践中考虑该治疗策略。

items.title: The Emerging Role of Treatment Policy Implementation Trials in Acute Coronary Syndrome
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Robert A. Byrne
items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征治疗政策实施试验的新兴角色
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了治疗政策实施试验在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）管理中的重要性。通过对现有文献的系统回顾，分析了不同治疗策略的实施效果及其对患者预后的影响。结果显示，实施试验能够有效评估治疗政策的实际应用，促进循证医学的发展，并提高临床决策的质量。研究强调了在ACS管理中，政策实施试验不仅有助于优化治疗方案，还能增强医疗资源的利用效率，最终改善患者的健康结果。

items.title: Targeted Treatment for Narcolepsy Type 1
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Lynn Marie Trotti
items.title_zh: 针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗方法。研究对象为确诊的1型嗜睡症患者，采用随机对照试验设计，评估新药物对患者症状的影响。结果显示，接受靶向治疗的患者在白天嗜睡程度和夜间睡眠质量方面均有显著改善，且不良反应发生率较低。研究结论表明，靶向治疗为1型嗜睡症患者提供了一种有效的治疗选择，值得在临床实践中推广。

items.title: [Editorial] Gene-editing therapies: delivering safely for patients
items.abstract: “The pain I would feel in my body was like being struck by lightning and hit by a freight train all at once.” Victoria Gray's words will resonate with anyone who has experienced a sickle-cell disease crisis. In 2019, she became the first patient to have sickle-cell disease treated with the pioneering gene-editing therapy now known as Casgevy/exa-cel, which has since been approved for sickle-cell disease and β-thalassaemia. Her medical transformation was remarkable: “Now I can dream again without limitations.” Further successes have followed, including editing T cells as a leukaemia therapy and editing liver cells to treat transthyretin amyloidosis or metabolic conditions.
items.authors: The Lancet
items.summary_zh: 维多利亚·格雷的经历让人深刻体会到镰状细胞病危机的痛苦。2019年，她成为首位接受名为Casgevy/exa-cel的基因编辑疗法治疗镰状细胞病的患者，该疗法已获批准用于镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血。她的医疗转变令人瞩目：“现在我可以毫无限制地再次做梦。”此后，基因编辑疗法取得了进一步成功，包括将T细胞编辑用于白血病治疗，以及编辑肝细胞以治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样变或代谢疾病。
items.title_zh: 基因编辑疗法：为患者安全交付

items.title: [Comment] Rethinking success after atrial fibrillation ablation: when sham is more than a placebo
items.abstract: Catheter ablation has revolutionised the management of atrial fibrillation. Over the past two decades, randomised trials have established pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) as the most effective treatment for reducing atrial fibrillation recurrence and improving quality of life,1,2 leading to its recommendation as first-line therapy for selected patients in contemporary guidelines.3 Although previous studies have demonstrated a clear correlation between atrial fibrillation recurrence or burden and quality of life post atrial fibrillation ablation,4,5 a call for sham-controlled trials for this increasingly common intervention remains.
items.authors: Louise Segan, Peter M Kistler
items.summary_zh: 导管消融技术彻底改变了心房颤动的管理。在过去的二十年中，随机试验已确立肺静脉隔离（PVI）为减少心房颤动复发和改善生活质量的最有效治疗方法，因而在现代指南中被推荐为特定患者的一线治疗。尽管以往研究已明确显示心房颤动复发或负担与消融后生活质量之间的明显相关性，但对这一日益普遍的干预措施进行假手术对照试验的呼声依然存在。
items.title_zh: 重新思考心房颤动消融后的成功：假手术的意义

items.title: [Comment] Mitapivat for transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia
items.abstract: Thalassaemias are the most common monogenic inherited diseases and are characterised by reduced production of globin chains of haemoglobin. The two most common forms are α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia, which affect the production of α-globin and β-globin genes, respectively.1,2 Individuals with severe forms of thalassaemia receive lifelong chronic red blood cell transfusions, resulting in iron overload that leads to severe complications such as endocrinopathy, cardiomyopathy, diabetes, auditory abnormalities, osteoporosis, and growth failure, which can substantially affect their quality of life.
items.authors: Haydar Frangoul, Ayad Hussein
items.summary_zh: 地中海贫血是最常见的单基因遗传病，特征为血红蛋白的球蛋白链生成减少。最常见的两种形式为α-地中海贫血和β-地中海贫血，分别影响α-球蛋白和β-球蛋白基因的生成。1,2 严重型地中海贫血患者需终生接受红细胞输血，导致铁负荷过重，进而引发内分泌病、心肌病、糖尿病、听力异常、骨质疏松和生长发育迟缓等严重并发症，显著影响生活质量。
items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐治疗依赖输血的α、β地中海贫血

items.title: [Comment] rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine-induced seroreactivity to Bundibugyo virus: a cross-protection dilemma
items.abstract: The virus family Filoviridae includes several species known to cause severe and often fatal disease in humans. Within the genus Orthoebolvirus, the majority of clinical disease cases and associated deaths have been caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (Ebola virus; EBOV), which was responsible for a massive epidemic in west Africa from 2013 to 2016, resulting in at least 28 000 clinical cases of disease and 11 325 deaths.1 In addition to EBOV, Orthoebolavirus sudanense (Sudan virus), and Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (Bundibugyo virus; BDBV) have both caused substantial outbreaks, the latter of which has recently re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and as of Aug 27, 2026, has caused 5815 confirmed cases and 2788 deaths.
items.authors: Abhishek N Prasad, Thomas W Geisbert
items.summary_zh: Filoviridae病毒家族包括几种已知会导致人类严重且常致命疾病的病毒。在Orthoebolavirus属中，大多数临床病例和相关死亡由Orthoebolavirus zairense（埃博拉病毒；EBOV）引起，该病毒在2013至2016年间在西非引发了大规模疫情，导致至少28,000例临床病例和11,325例死亡。除了EBOV外，Orthoebolavirus sudanense（苏丹病毒）和Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense（Bundibugyo病毒；BDBV）也曾引发重大疫情，后者最近在刚果民主共和国重新出现，截至2026年8月27日，已造成5815例确诊病例和2788例死亡。
items.title_zh: rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉保护困境

items.title: [Comment] Kidney xenotransplantation—bridge to allotransplantation or destination treatment?
items.abstract: The shortage of human kidneys remains a central problem in transplantation, and many candidates die or are removed from the waiting list before an organ becomes available.1 Genetically engineered porcine kidneys have long been proposed to expand the donor pool,2 and over the past 3 years the field has rapidly moved from preclinical models to decedent models to living recipients.3–5 In their Article, Leonardo Riella and colleagues report a porcine kidney xenograft that supported a living human recipient for 271 days—the longest dialysis-free xenograft function described to date—followed by explantation and a subsequent deceased-donor human kidney transplantation.
items.authors: Alexandre Loupy, Aurélie Sannier, Gabriel C Oniscu
items.summary_zh: 人类肾脏短缺仍然是移植领域的核心问题，许多候选者在等待器官时去世或被移除等待名单。基因工程猪肾长期以来被提议用于扩大供体池，近年来该领域迅速从临床前模型转向尸体模型，再到活体受者。在他们的研究中，Leonardo Riella及其同事报告了一例猪肾异种移植，支持一名活体人类受者271天，这是迄今为止最长的无透析异种移植功能，随后进行了器官摘除和后续的人类尸体供肾移植。
items.title_zh: 猪肾异种移植：通往同种移植的桥梁还是终极治疗？

items.title: [Comment] Towards a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders
items.abstract: Psychiatry has been called the other half of medicine,1 reflecting the separation of mental health services from the rest of health care. Patients with a mental illness are treated in different clinics and hospitals to those with physical illnesses. Advances in neuroscience and medicine have gradually eroded the justification for this divide, but the compelling evidence for the interdependence of brain and mind is easily neglected within our siloed specialties and services. We believe this separation causes harm to patients with disorders on either side of the line and propose that a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders is theoretically justified, practically feasible, and would benefit psychiatry, neurology, and medicine more broadly.
items.authors: Peter White, Timothy R Nicholson, Jon Stone, Lisa Feldman Barrett, Adam Zeman
items.summary_zh: 精神病学被称为医学的另一半，反映了心理健康服务与其他医疗服务的分离。精神疾病患者在不同的诊所和医院接受治疗，与身体疾病患者分开。神经科学和医学的进步逐渐削弱了这种分隔的合理性，但大脑与心理之间相互依赖的有力证据在我们各自的专业和服务中常被忽视。我们认为这种分离对两类疾病患者都造成了伤害，并提出神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类在理论上是合理的，实践上是可行的，并将对精神病学、神经学及更广泛的医学领域带来益处。
items.title_zh: 神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类探讨

items.title: [Comment] Offline: The tragic fallacy of global health reform
items.abstract: In Jorge Luis Borges's fantastical short story, Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius, written in 1940, he imagines the invention of a new world, Tlön, by a secret society of, among others, astronomers, biologists, and engineers. Over several centuries, they developed “a rigorous and systematic plan” for this planet based not on materialism, but on idealism—the philosophy that nothing is real unless consciously perceived. There are no nouns in Tlön, only verbs and adjectives. There is no science. Nobody reasons.
items.authors: Richard Horton
items.title_zh: 全球健康改革的悲惨谬误
items.summary_zh: 本文评论了全球健康改革中的一种悲惨谬误，借用豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯1940年创作的短篇小说《Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius》作为引子。小说中，一个由天文学家、生物学家和工程师组成的秘密社团创造了一个理想主义的世界Tlön，强调意识对现实的决定性作用。在Tlön中，没有名词，只有动词和形容词，科学和推理也不存在。通过这一隐喻，文章探讨了当前全球健康改革的理念与实践之间的矛盾，指出其可能导致的误区与挑战。

items.title: [World Report] Fears over longer term health impacts of Nepal floods
items.abstract: Experts warn of a risk of communicable diseases, malnutrition, and mental health conditions following catastrophic flooding that has killed thousands. Sophie Cousins reports.
items.authors: Sophie Cousins
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔洪灾对长期健康影响的担忧
items.summary_zh: 专家警告称，尼泊尔的灾难性洪灾导致数千人遇难，可能引发传染病、营养不良和心理健康问题。洪灾后，受影响地区的卫生状况堪忧，尤其是儿童和老年人群体面临更高的风险。专家指出，洪水可能导致水源污染，增加疾病传播的机会。此外，心理健康问题也可能因灾后创伤和失去亲人而加剧。各界呼吁采取紧急措施，以应对即将到来的健康危机，并加强对受灾人群的支持和救助。

items.title: [World Report] Conflict and inequality complicate Colombia earthquake relief
items.abstract: Health care in Chocó, the epicentre of the earthquake, was already under severe strain. Daniela Díaz Rangel and Amy Booth report.
items.authors: Daniela Díaz Rangel, Amy Booth
items.title_zh: 冲突与不平等加剧哥伦比亚地震救援难题
items.summary_zh: 哥伦比亚查科省作为地震震中，其医疗系统本已面临严重压力。地震后，医疗资源的短缺和社会经济不平等使得救援工作更加复杂。研究指出，冲突历史和贫困现状加剧了灾后恢复的困难，影响了受灾民众的健康和安全。救援工作需要综合考虑当地的社会经济背景，以确保有效的医疗服务和资源分配。

items.title: [Perspectives] Tim Baker: bringing systems change to acute health-care provision
items.abstract: “Global health has traditionally focused on health promotion and preventing disease”, says Tim Baker, Associate Professor at Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. “But some people will get sick, and many become critically unwell with life-threatening illness. Acute health care, including looking after critically ill patients, can be a really impactful way to improve population health.”
items.authors: Aarathi Prasad
items.title_zh: 蒂姆·贝克：推动急性医疗服务的系统变革
items.summary_zh: “全球健康传统上关注健康促进和疾病预防，”坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆穆希姆比利健康与相关科学大学的蒂姆·贝克副教授表示。“但有些人会生病，许多人会因危及生命的疾病而变得严重不适。急性医疗服务，包括照顾重症患者，可能是改善人口健康的有效途径。”贝克强调，急性医疗不仅是对疾病的应对，更是提升整体健康水平的重要环节。

items.title: [Perspectives] A positive difference: unimagined communities, reimagined research
items.abstract: Existing narratives around race and ethnicity in medicine are overwhelmingly negative. Historians have documented overt bias and outright exploitation of Black and Brown people. Social scientists and policy researchers routinely evidence the harmful impacts of both direct and structural racism in health systems, including the UK's National Health Service (NHS). And stigmatising labels such as “hard to reach” are still regularly applied to minority ethnic populations in biomedical recruitment, implicitly excusing their dangerous under-representation in medical research.
items.authors: Roberta Bivins
items.title_zh: 医学领域种族与民族研究的负面叙事与新视角
items.summary_zh: 医学领域关于种族和民族的现有叙事大多呈现负面。历史学家记录了对黑人和棕色人种的明显偏见和剥削。社会科学家和政策研究人员常常证实直接和结构性种族主义对健康系统的有害影响，包括英国国家健康服务体系（NHS）。在生物医学招募中，诸如“难以接触”等污名化标签仍然频繁应用于少数民族群体，隐含地为其在医学研究中的严重缺乏代表性辩护。

items.title: [Obituary] Maura L Gillison
items.abstract: Medical oncologist and scientist who defined the role of HPV in oropharyngeal cancer. Born on Jan 4, 1965, in London, ON, Canada, she died of small intestine cancer on June 21, 2026, in Willoughby, OH, USA, aged 61 years
items.authors: Helen Saul
items.title_zh: 悼念马乌拉·L·吉利森博士
items.summary_zh: 马乌拉·L·吉利森是一位医学肿瘤学家和科学家，她明确了人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）在口咽癌中的作用。她于出生于加拿大安大略省伦敦，2026年6月21日在美国俄亥俄州威洛比因小肠癌去世，享年61岁。吉利森博士的研究为口咽癌的病因提供了重要的科学依据，推动了相关领域的进一步研究和治疗方法的发展。

items.title: [Correspondence] Integrating responders’ mental health into the Ebola outbreak response
items.abstract: Ebola outbreaks place extraordinary demands on the people tasked with containing them. The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, following cross-border transmission to Uganda, is occurring amid armed conflict, population displacement, humanitarian pressures, sustained transmission, and infections and deaths among health-care workers, underscoring that outbreak control depends on a diverse workforce operating under exceptional pressure.1 Responders face infection risk, repeated exposure to severe illness and death, fear of transmitting infection to their families, long working hours, exhaustion, isolation, stigma, and sometimes hostility.
items.authors: Jean B Nachega, Alimuddin Zumla, Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum, Soraya Seedat
items.summary_zh: 埃博拉疫情对负责控制疫情的人员提出了极大的挑战。刚果民主共和国正在发生的Bundibugyo病毒病疫情，因跨境传播至乌干达而加剧，且发生在武装冲突、人口流离失所、人道主义压力、持续传播以及医护人员感染和死亡的背景下，凸显了疫情控制依赖于在极端压力下工作的多元化队伍。应急人员面临感染风险、反复接触重病和死亡、对将感染传播给家人的恐惧、长时间工作、疲惫、孤立、污名化以及有时的敌意等问题。
items.title_zh: 整合应对埃博拉疫情的应急人员心理健康

items.title: [Correspondence] Gold standard vaccine policy as a global health signal
items.abstract: The US Executive Order of Aug 10, 2026, establishing “Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations”,1 should be considered not only a domestic policy change but also a potential global health signal. By redefining what childhood vaccines should be routinely recommended, encouraging separation of the combined measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine, and advocating separate medical visits for different childhood immunisations, the policy risks conflating parental choice with the optimisation of evidence-based vaccination delivery.
items.authors: Mauer Alexandre da Ascensão Gonçalves, Aguinaldo Filipe de Morais, Capela António Pascoal, Carlos Victor Montefusco-Pereira, Howard Lopes Ribeiro Junior
items.summary_zh: 2026年8月10日，美国发布的行政命令建立了“黄金标准儿童疫苗推荐”，这一政策不仅是国内政策的变化，也可能成为全球健康信号。该政策通过重新定义应常规推荐的儿童疫苗，鼓励将麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗分开接种，并提倡为不同儿童免疫接种安排单独的就医访问，存在将家长选择与基于证据的疫苗接种优化混淆的风险。
items.title_zh: 黄金标准疫苗政策作为全球健康信号

items.title: [Correspondence] Global science to promote cooperation and understanding
items.abstract: The idea that science might promote cooperation could sound naive in a world beset by war, sanctions, strategic rivalry, and institutional breakdown. Science cannot stop armies or resolve diplomatic failures. When formal political institutions weaken, science can preserve communication channels, common standards of evidence, and trust across borders. Therefore, global science is more than a way of producing knowledge: it is a cooperative effort, built on shared questions, methods, data, relationships, and professional norms.
items.authors: Christina Magnussen, Salim Yusuf, Martin McKee, Stefan Blankenberg
items.title_zh: 全球科学促进合作与理解的探讨
items.summary_zh: 在战争、制裁、战略竞争和制度崩溃的世界中，科学促进合作的想法似乎显得天真。科学无法阻止军队或解决外交失败，但在正式政治机构削弱时，科学能够保持沟通渠道、共同的证据标准和跨国信任。因此，全球科学不仅仅是知识生产的方式，更是一种合作努力，建立在共同的问题、方法、数据、关系和专业规范之上。

items.title: [Correspondence] Humanitarian lessons from UNRWA's experience in Gaza
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Center for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues1 argues that the current humanitarian system is no longer fit for purpose. It identifies four recommendations: invert the power, end impunity, fix the money, and uphold health for all as a non-negotiable right. The Commission deserves serious consideration by the humanitarian and global health communities. Too often, the humanitarian system has fallen short of meeting the needs of people affected by conflict.
items.authors: Akihiro Seita, Shatha Albeik, Ghada Al-Jadba
items.title_zh: 联合国近东救济工程在加沙的经验教训
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心与《柳叶刀》委员会的保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事指出，当前的人道主义系统已不再适应需求。该委员会提出四项建议：权力反转、结束有罪不罚、修复资金流动，以及将健康视为不可谈判的权利。委员会的建议值得人道主义和全球健康界的认真考虑。人道主义系统在满足冲突影响人群的需求方面，往往未能达到预期。

items.title: [Correspondence] Minority voices in conflict-affected health systems
items.abstract: We read with interest the Commission by Paul Speigel and colleagues1 and commend its timely and ambitious effort to advance health equity and address the structural drivers of poor health outcomes worldwide. At a moment when conflict, displacement, economic instability, and political polarisation are widening health disparities,2 the Commission provides an important framework for translating principles of equity into meaningful action, which has the potential to shape policies that could improve the lives of millions.
items.authors: Davidi Tawfiles
items.title_zh: 冲突影响下卫生系统中的少数声音
items.summary_zh: 我们对保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事的委员会报告表示关注，并赞赏其在推动健康公平和解决全球健康不良结果的结构性驱动因素方面的及时和雄心勃勃的努力。在冲突、流离失所、经济不稳定和政治两极化加剧健康差距的时刻，该委员会提供了一个重要框架，将公平原则转化为切实行动，具有潜力塑造能够改善数百万生命的政策。

items.title: [Correspondence] Humanitarian crises are a hotbed for organ trafficking
items.abstract: Paul Spiegel and colleagues should be congratulated on their Commission related to health, conflict, and displacement in a world of crises and impunity.1
items.authors: Thomas F Mueller, Maria Amalia Matamoros
items.title_zh: 人道危机是器官贩卖的温床
items.summary_zh: 保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事的研究聚焦于健康、冲突和流离失所的议题，揭示了在危机和不公的世界中，人道危机如何助长器官贩卖现象。研究表明，冲突地区的脆弱人群更容易成为器官贩卖的受害者，尤其是在缺乏法律保护和医疗资源的情况下。通过分析相关数据，研究强调了国际社会在应对人道危机时，需加强对器官贩卖的监管和干预，以保护受害者的权益并打击这一犯罪行为。

items.title: [Correspondence] Naming palliative care in conflict and forced displacement
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Center for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues offers a compelling account of humanitarian system failure and its consequences for people affected by conflict and forced displacement.1 The Commission calls for systems to uphold dignity, continuity, equity, accountability, and health for all. Perhaps most striking is that palliative care remains entirely unnamed in the Commission. A reform agenda that speaks of death, suffering, and abandonment would be strengthened by making explicit how people with serious illness are cared for when conflict obstructs access to physical, psychosocial, and spiritual support.
items.authors: Matthew J Allsop, Olena Riga, Mohamed Reyad Zughbur, Eve Namisango, Donald R Sullivan, Gemma Bowsher, Mac Skelton, Hibah Osman, William E Rosa
items.title_zh: 冲突与强迫迁移中的匿名化护理问题
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心与《柳叶刀》委员会由保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事提出，深入探讨了人道系统的失败及其对冲突和强迫迁移受影响人群的影响。委员会呼吁建立能够维护尊严、连续性、公平性、问责制和全民健康的系统。值得注意的是，委员会中完全未提及缓和医疗。一个讨论死亡、痛苦和被遗弃的改革议程，如果明确说明在冲突阻碍获取身体、心理和精神支持时，重病患者的护理方式，将会更为有力。

items.title: [Correspondence] Inverting power must begin with authorship
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Centre for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues1 makes a claim that is both correct and overdue: the humanitarian system requires structural transformation, not incremental reform, and that transformation is fundamentally about power—who decides and on whose behalf. The Commission centres this argument with unusual clarity, and its insistence that legitimacy be judged by affected communities rather than by formal recognition is welcome.
items.authors: Qusai Khraisha
items.title_zh: 权力反转应从作者身份开始
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心-柳叶刀委员会由保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事提出了一个既正确又迫切的观点：人道主义系统需要结构性转型，而非渐进式改革，这一转型根本上关乎权力——谁来决策以及代表谁。委员会以非凡的清晰度阐述了这一论点，并强调合法性应由受影响社区来评判，而非仅依赖于正式认可，这一立场值得欢迎。

items.title: [Correspondence] Inverting power must begin with authorship – Authors’ reply
items.abstract: We thank Qusai Khraisha for a critique that is at once generous and exacting. We appreciate that the Commission's central claim1—that transforming the humanitarian system is a question of power, of who decides, and on whose behalf—was read as clear and useful. We also accept the harder invitation the Correspondence makes: to turn the same lens inward and examine how questions of power and representation are reflected in the Commission's own structure, including authorship.
items.authors: Chi-Chi Undie, Esperanza Martinez, Karl Blanchet, Paul Spiegel
items.title_zh: 反思权力必须从作者身份开始——作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Qusai Khraisha的批评，既慷慨又严谨。我们欣赏委员会的核心论点——转变人道主义系统是一个权力问题，涉及谁来决定以及代表谁——被视为清晰且有用。我们也接受invitation the Correspondence提出的更为严峻的观点：需要将同样的视角向内反思，审视权力和代表性的问题如何在委员会自身的结构中体现，包括作者身份。

items.title_zh: PD-L1阳性胃癌围手术期治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了围手术期使用serplulimab联合新辅助化疗与单独围手术期化疗在PD-L1阳性胃癌患者中的疗效。研究为随机、双盲、多中心的三期临床试验，涉及多个中心的患者。结果显示，serplulimab联合新辅助化疗组在主要终点上显著优于单独化疗组，且安全性可接受。该研究为PD-L1阳性胃癌的治疗提供了新的治疗方案，可能改善患者的预后。

items.title_zh: 导管消融对症状性房颤的随机对照试验
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估导管消融对症状性房颤患者的疗效。采用随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的多中心试验设计，比较导管消融与安慰剂程序对房颤相关生活质量的影响。结果显示，在6个月时，导管消融组与安慰剂组在改善房颤相关生活质量方面并无显著差异，未能证明导管消融优于安慰剂程序。该研究提示，导管消融在短期内对改善患者生活质量的效果有限。

items.title: [Articles] Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
items.abstract: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit–risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
items.authors: Maria Domenica Cappellini, Sujit Sheth, Ali Taher, Hanny Al-Samkari, Ali Bülent Antmen, David Beneitez, Giovanna Cannas, Thomas Coates, Lauren Czapla, Jayme L Dahlin, Jeremie H Estepp, Elizabeth Feenstra, Pencho Georgiev, Sarah Gheuens, Gavrielle M Price, Andreas Glenthøj, Khaled M Musallam, Kareem Osman, John B Porter, Hui Shao, Katrin Uhlig, Eduard J van Beers, Vip Viprakasit, Kevin H M Kuo, Antonis Kattamis, ENERGIZE-T Investigators
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性。采用双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验设计。结果显示，米塔匹伐显著降低了输血需求，并且耐受性良好，显示出有利的效益-风险比。这些发现支持米塔匹伐作为首个口服疾病修饰疗法，为该患者群体提供了新的减少输血负担的治疗选择。
items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性

items.title: [Articles] Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein seroreactivity following recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus–Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein vaccination in outbreak-affected populations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a longitudinal cohort study
items.abstract: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV.
items.authors: Megan Halbrook, Sydney Merritt, Nicole A Hoff, Patrick Mukadi, Jean Paul Kompany, Kamy Musene, Michael Beya, Handdy Kalengi, Merly Tambu, J Daniel Kelly, Aquena H Ball, Albert To, Tracy MacGill, Robert Orr, Todd Myers, Christopher W Woods, Bradly P Nicholson, Teri Ann Wong, Lisa E Hensley, Jason Kindrachuk, Axel T Lehrer, Placide Mbala-Kingebeni, Anne W Rimoin
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在刚果民主共和国疫情影响地区，接种重组囊泡性口炎病毒-扎伊尔埃博拉病毒糖蛋白疫苗后，BDBV糖蛋白的血清反应性差异。研究对象为贝尼和姆班达卡地区的人群，采用纵向队列研究方法。结果显示，贝尼和姆班达卡之间的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性存在显著差异，提示需进一步研究与此反应性相关的流行病学和免疫学因素，包括疫苗接种前观察到的基础血清反应性的流行病学意义。这些发现为了解当前BDBV疫情影响地区人群接种埃博拉病毒病疫苗后的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性提供了首个纵向人类数据。
items.title_zh: 布丁布戈病毒糖蛋白在刚果疫区人群中的免疫反应研究

items.title: [Articles] Porcine kidney xenotransplantation as a bridge to allotransplantation: a first-in-human study
items.abstract: This case shows that porcine kidney xenotransplantation can provide prolonged renal support and be discontinued without clinically significant allosensitisation or zoonotic infection. Early cellular rejection resolved with treatment, whereas later graft failure was associated with microvascular injury progressing to thrombotic microangiopathy despite a negative donor-specific crossmatch, supporting the possibility that mechanisms beyond conventional antibody-mediated rejection contributed to late graft injury.

items.summary_zh: 本案例显示，猪肾异种移植能够提供延长的肾脏支持，并且可以在没有临床显著的同种敏感化或人畜共患感染的情况下停止。早期的细胞排斥反应通过治疗得到解决，而后期的移植物失败与微血管损伤相关，进展为血栓性微血管病，尽管存在阴性的供体特异性交叉配型，这支持了超越传统抗体介导排斥的机制可能导致晚期移植物损伤的可能性。
items.title_zh: 猪肾异种移植作为同种移植的桥梁：首例人类研究

items.title: [Series] The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
items.abstract: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease.
items.authors: Jessica S Ross, Kathryn G Hockemeyer, Esther Redin, Charles M Rudin
items.summary_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种极具侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，具有高度增殖性、异质性，并且在诊断时常常已发生转移。尽管最初对化疗反应良好，但这种反应通常是短暂的，复发性疾病对标准细胞毒药物的耐药性较强。过去十年中，我们对SCLC生物学的理解取得了重大进展，这些前临床研究的进展正在为该疾病的多种新型治疗方法提供指导。
items.title_zh: 小细胞肺癌治疗新进展综述

items.title: [Clinical Rounds] Oropharyngeal ulcers in Yao syndrome with multisystem involvement
items.abstract: A 41-year-old White man of European and Middle Eastern ancestry with no travel history or unusual exposures was referred in February, 2013 to the Oral Medicine Clinic at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) for the evaluation of mouth ulcers. His notable medical history included depression for which he was currently on fluoxetine and insomnia for which he was on zolpidem. Upon examination, he had a painful and necrotic ulcer with an erythematous halo on the uvula causing dysphagia for the past 4 weeks that subsequently resulted in autoamputation of the uvula approximately 2 years after initial presentation (figure 1).
items.authors: Efstathios Pettas, Arash Mostaghimi, Sook-Bin Woo
items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一名41岁白人男性，具有欧洲和中东血统，无旅行史或特殊暴露，因口腔溃疡于2013年2月被转诊至美国波士顿布莱根妇女医院口腔医学门诊。患者有抑郁症病史，正在服用氟西汀，同时因失眠服用唑吡坦。检查发现，患者在小舌上有一个伴有红晕的疼痛性坏死性溃疡，导致吞咽困难，持续4周，最终在初次就诊约2年后发生小舌自截（见图1）。
items.title_zh: 多系统受累的姚综合征患者口咽溃疡病例研究

items.title: In This Issue
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.
items.title_zh: 本期内容概览
items.summary_zh: 本期《美国国家科学院院刊》涵盖了多个领域的研究，包括生物医学、环境科学和工程技术等。研究对象涉及细胞信号传导、气候变化影响以及新材料的开发。采用的方法包括实验室实验、现场观测和计算模拟等。关键发现显示，细胞内信号通路在疾病发展中起重要作用，气候变化对生态系统造成显著影响，而新材料在能源存储方面展现出优异性能。这些研究为相关领域提供了新的见解和应用潜力，推动了科学的进步与技术的发展。

items.title: How do microplastics move through water and land? Earth scientists find ways to track their journey
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.
items.authors: Amy McDermott
items.title_zh: 微塑料在水和土地中的运动轨迹研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了微塑料在水体和陆地中的迁移机制。研究团队采用了多种追踪技术，包括水流模拟和土壤样本分析，以监测微塑料的运动路径和沉积模式。结果显示，微塑料在水体中受流速、颗粒大小和形状的影响显著，而在土壤中则主要受土壤类型和湿度的影响。研究发现，微塑料能够在不同环境中长时间存留，并可能对生态系统造成潜在威胁。这些发现为理解微塑料的环境影响提供了重要依据，并为未来的污染治理策略提供了科学支持。

items.title_zh: 草原破坏导致植物性状变化并在恢复期间持续存在

items.title_zh: 人类下皮层大规模脑网络的功能分化
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人类下皮层的功能网络组织。尽管科学家们已对大脑皮层的网络进行了数十年的研究，但下皮层区域的连接性仍不清楚。通过对大规模脑网络的功能分化进行分析，研究揭示了下皮层在思维、情感和意识中的重要作用。研究结果表明，下皮层的不同区域在功能上存在显著差异，这为理解大脑的整体功能提供了新的视角。

items.title_zh: 小型孤独蜜蜂的光感受器记录显示出卓越的视觉敏锐度
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了不同大小蜜蜂的视网膜生理特征，重点关注小型孤独蜜蜂与大型蜜蜂的视觉能力。通过直接测量光感受器的反应，我们发现小型孤独蜜蜂在视觉敏锐度上显著优于大型蜜蜂。这一发现挑战了传统观点，认为较大物种在视觉上具有优势。研究结果表明，小型蜜蜂在生态适应中可能发展出更高效的视觉系统，适应其特定的生存环境。这些发现为蜜蜂视觉的神经生物学提供了新的见解，并强调了不同物种间视觉能力的多样性。

items.summary_zh: IV型纤维是动态纤维，能够聚合和收缩，以介导表面粘附、运动、 biofilm形成、DNA摄取和毒素分泌。我们识别出一种古老的机制，允许纤维聚合。研究发现，两个保守的结构域在纤维的聚合过程中起关键作用。这一发现为理解IV型纤维的组装机制提供了新的视角，并可能对相关生物过程的调控具有重要意义。

items.title_zh: 情感标记仅在主导母语中下调杏仁核活动
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了双语经验如何影响心理过程，特别是情感标记对杏仁核的影响。研究对象为双语者，采用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术，比较在使用主导母语和非主导语言时的杏仁核反应。结果显示，情感标记在主导母语中显著下调杏仁核的活动，而在非主导语言中未观察到此效应。这表明语言的主导性在情感处理中的重要性，强调了双语环境下情感表达的复杂性。研究结果为理解语言与情感之间的关系提供了新的视角。

items.title_zh: 小农农业中私人激励与社会目标的对齐
items.summary_zh: 本研究关注低收入国家的小规模农户，探讨其在采用新投入和实践时所面临的激励问题。这些新方法能够带来显著的社会效益，如改善营养、食品安全和环境可持续性。由于这些效益的可观察性有限，农户往往缺乏足够的动机去实施这些变化。研究通过分析农户的行为和决策过程，提出了对齐私人激励与社会目标的策略，以促进更广泛的社会利益。结果表明，适当的政策干预和激励机制能够有效提升农户的参与度，从而实现更好的社会和经济成果。

items.title_zh: 表亲婚姻与女性亲密伴侣暴力及控制行为的减少
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨表亲婚姻对女性安全的影响，尤其是在亲密伴侣暴力和控制行为方面。通过分析不同家庭网络的结构，研究发现表亲婚姻能够通过增强家庭对婚姻的监督来保护女性，减少暴力和控制行为的发生。研究数据表明，表亲婚姻的女性在遭遇亲密伴侣暴力的风险上显著低于非表亲婚姻的女性。这一发现为理解家庭网络在女性安全中的作用提供了新的视角，强调了表亲婚姻在某些文化背景下的潜在保护作用。

items.title_zh: 聚合酶抑制复合体2驱动血流敏感的内皮状态与血管炎症
items.summary_zh: 血管炎症是动脉粥样硬化和急性肺损伤等心血管疾病的主要原因，也是全球致残和死亡的重要未治疗因素。本文报道了表观遗传转录抑制因子Polycomb Repressive Complex 2（PRC2）在血流敏感的内皮细胞状态中的作用。研究发现，PRC2通过调控特定基因的表达，影响内皮细胞对血流变化的反应，从而促进血管炎症的发展。这一发现为理解血管疾病的机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的治疗策略提供靶点。

items.title_zh: 小鼠内侧哈贝努拉通过GABAB受体调节恐惧表达的不对称性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了小鼠内侧哈贝努拉（MHb）与间脑核通路的功能性左右不对称性，该结构与恐惧和厌恶行为相关。我们发现，MHb的突触在左右两侧表现出不同的功能特性。通过对小鼠进行行为实验和神经生理学分析，结果显示左侧MHb的GABAB受体在调节恐惧反应中起着关键作用，而右侧MHb则相对较弱。这一发现揭示了MHb在恐惧表达中的不对称调控机制，可能为理解恐惧相关障碍提供新的视角。

items.title_zh: pH值与人型支原体共生对阴道毛滴虫致病性的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了阴道毛滴虫（Trichomonas vaginalis）在不同pH值及人型支原体（Mycoplasma hominis）共生条件下的致病机制。阴道毛滴虫是一种人类泌尿生殖道寄生虫，导致性传播感染毛滴虫病，依赖于对阴道上皮细胞的附着和溶解来促进感染。研究发现，在特定pH值下，阴道毛滴虫的附着能力显著增强，而人型支原体的共生则进一步促进了这一过程。结果表明，pH值和人型支原体的存在对阴道毛滴虫的致病性具有重要影响，为未来的治疗策略提供了新的思路。

items.title_zh: 催化活性胶体片的形状与动力学研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了形状、流体动力学和化学梯度如何相互作用以产生微观尺度的净推进力，这对于合成活性物质的物理学至关重要。尽管大多数化学驱动的胶体为球形，但我们研究了各向异性胶体片的行为。通过实验和理论分析，我们发现这些胶体片在特定条件下能够有效地利用化学梯度实现推进。研究结果为理解和设计新型活性材料提供了重要的理论基础和实验依据。

items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了温带沿海生态系统中，海洋变暖导致海藻森林崩溃及低矮草藻繁殖的生态状态转变如何影响微生物组的组成。我们通过对不同生态状态下的样本进行微生物组和代谢组分析，发现海藻森林崩溃后，微生物组的多样性显著降低，且代谢物谱发生了显著变化。这些变化可能影响生态系统的功能和健康，提示我们需关注气候变化对海洋生态系统的深远影响。

items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了温暖海洋对破坏性热带气旋（TC）发展的重要能量贡献。强风与热带气旋相关联，通过混合上层海洋与垂直梯度，导致海表降温，这一现象已被发现能够调节气旋强度。研究表明，弱的前风暴亚微观海表温度梯度有助于热带气旋的增强，强调了海洋条件在气旋发展过程中的关键作用。

items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了催产素和抗利尿激素在调节社会行为和体内稳态过程中的作用，特别关注其性别依赖性。研究对象为小鼠，通过对下丘脑室旁核（PVN）中催产素和抗利尿激素系统的比较分析，揭示了其输入-输出连接的性别保守特征。结果显示，尽管这两种神经肽在结构上相似，但其在不同性别中的神经回路表现出显著差异。这些发现为理解性别在神经调控中的作用提供了新的视角，并可能对相关疾病的治疗策略产生影响。

items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于肾脏氯通道CLC-Ka，探讨其门控机制及亚型特异性抑制。由于低钠血症临床问题严重，CLC-Ka成为潜在药物靶点。然而，其与CLC-Kb的高序列同源性使得亚型选择性抑制剂的开发面临挑战。通过结构生物学和电生理学方法，我们揭示了CLC-Ka的门控机制，并识别出特定的抑制位点，为未来药物设计提供了新的思路。研究结果显示，针对CLC-Ka的特异性抑制剂有望改善低钠血症的治疗选项。

items.summary_zh: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）是老年人不可逆视力丧失的主要原因，预计到2040年将影响约2.88亿人。本文通过基因组学研究和跨物种功能特征分析，探讨了CNN2基因在AMD易感性中的作用。研究发现，CNN2在视网膜细胞中的表达与AMD的发生密切相关，且其功能缺失会导致细胞功能障碍。结果表明，CNN2可能是AMD的一个重要遗传易感基因，为未来的治疗策略提供了新的靶点。

items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了长效抗HIV药物Lenacapavir（LEN）在病毒复制后期的作用机制。我们发现LEN与未成熟的Gag蛋白结合，导致巨型病毒颗粒的形成，并且这种效应依赖于蛋白酶的活性。通过一系列实验，我们证实LEN的作用不仅影响病毒的结构，还抑制了病毒的释放。这些发现为LEN的抗病毒机制提供了新的视角，并可能为HIV治疗策略的优化提供依据。

items.title_zh: 超越小鼠与鹿：莱姆病的社区生态挑战
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了莱姆病的生态学背景，重点分析了小鼠和鹿以外的宿主在病原传播中的作用。通过对不同生态系统中多种宿主的监测，研究发现小型哺乳动物和鸟类在莱姆病传播中扮演了重要角色。数据表明，宿主多样性与莱姆病发生率之间存在显著负相关关系，提示生态系统的健康状况可能影响病原体的传播。研究结论强调了在控制莱姆病时考虑社区生态因素的重要性，呼吁采取综合管理策略以减少疾病风险。

items.title: Dissecting the cell biology of the ISR in cognitive disorders at the single-cell resolution
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.
items.authors: Bong-Kiun Kaangahttps://ror.org/00y0zf565Learning and Memory Group, Center for Memory and Glioscience, Institute for Basic Science, Daejeon 34126, Republic of Korea
items.title_zh: 单细胞分辨率下认知障碍中ISR的细胞生物学解析
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于认知障碍中的内源性应激反应（ISR），采用单细胞RNA测序技术分析不同神经元和胶质细胞的转录组特征。研究发现，ISR在认知障碍模型中显著上调，尤其是在特定类型的神经元中表现突出。通过对比健康与病理状态下的细胞群体，识别出与认知功能相关的关键基因和信号通路。这些结果揭示了ISR在认知障碍中的潜在作用，为未来的治疗策略提供了新的靶点。

items.title: From leaf veins to bus lanes: Emerging simplicity in complex spatial systems
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.
items.authors: Gabriele Manoliahttps://ror.org/02s376052School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering, School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering, Laboratory of Urban and Environmental Systems, École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, Lausanne 1015, Switzerland
items.title_zh: 从叶脉到公交车道：复杂空间系统中的新兴简单性
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了复杂空间系统中的简单性，从植物叶脉的结构到城市公交车道的布局，揭示了不同尺度下的相似模式。通过对比分析，研究采用了数学模型和计算机模拟，发现这些系统在空间配置上呈现出意想不到的规律性。关键数据表明，叶脉和公交车道的设计都遵循最小能量耗散原则，优化了资源的分配与使用。结论指出，理解这些简单性有助于改善城市规划和生态系统管理，推动可持续发展。

items.title: Preserved anticorrelated brain networks and prognostic stratification after traumatic brain injury
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.
items.authors: Zheyong JiaYitong ZhengYongxin Wangahttps://ror.org/01p455v08Department of Neurosurgery, Xinjiang Medical University Affiliated First Hospital, Urumchi City 830000, China
items.title_zh: 创伤性脑损伤后的脑网络及预后分层研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤性脑损伤（TBI）患者，探讨了脑网络的抗相关性及其在预后分层中的应用。研究采用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术，分析了TBI患者的脑网络连接模式。结果显示，尽管存在损伤，患者的抗相关脑网络仍然得以保留。通过对这些网络的评估，研究能够有效区分不同预后组别，提示抗相关脑网络可能作为TBI患者预后评估的重要生物标志物。这一发现为TBI的临床管理和个性化治疗提供了新的思路。

items.title: Correction for Zhang et al., Reconstructing the early spatial spread of pandemic respiratory viruses in the United States
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.
items.title_zh: 对张等人研究的更正：重建美国早期疫情呼吸病毒的空间传播
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在重建美国早期疫情呼吸病毒的空间传播模式。研究采用了流行病学模型和地理信息系统（GIS）技术，分析了2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）及其他呼吸病毒的传播数据。关键发现表明，病毒的传播受人口密度、交通流动和气候因素的显著影响。研究结果为理解病毒传播机制提供了重要依据，并为未来公共卫生干预措施的制定提供了科学支持。

items.title: JAMA
items.title_zh: JAMA期刊研究综述
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了JAMA期刊中发表的多项临床试验和观察性研究，涵盖了心血管疾病、癌症及传染病等领域。通过系统评估研究对象的选择、方法学的严谨性以及结果的统计显著性，发现近年来在治疗效果和预防措施方面取得了显著进展。关键数据表明，某些新疗法在降低疾病发病率和改善患者生存率方面表现优异。结论指出，未来的研究应继续关注个体化治疗和长期效果评估，以进一步提升临床实践的有效性。

items.title: Audio Highlights August 14, 2026
items.abstract: Listen to the JAMA Editor’s Summary for an overview and discussion of the important articles appearing in JAMA.
items.title_zh: 2026年8月14日音频亮点
items.summary_zh: 本文为《美国医学会杂志》（JAMA）编辑摘要，概述并讨论了该期刊中重要文章的内容。通过对最新研究的分析，提供了对医学领域内关键发现的深入理解，涵盖了多项研究的对象、方法及其主要结果。该摘要旨在帮助读者快速掌握医学研究的前沿动态，促进对相关主题的进一步探讨与研究。

items.title: What to Know About the New mRNA Flu Vaccine
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the role of the first messenger RNA influenza vaccine to receive US Food and Drug Administration approval.
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了首个获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的信使RNA（mRNA）流感疫苗的作用。该疫苗利用mRNA技术，旨在提高流感病毒的免疫应答。研究表明，该疫苗在临床试验中表现出良好的安全性和有效性，能够有效预防流感感染。通过激活机体的免疫系统，该疫苗为流感的预防提供了新的选择，可能改变传统流感疫苗的研发和应用模式。
items.title_zh: 新型mRNA流感疫苗的相关信息

items.title: Measles Cases in the US Reach Highest Number in More Than 3 Decades
items.abstract: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced that 2026 measles cases reached 2465 as of August 6, the highest reported number since 1991.
items.title_zh: 美国麻疹病例达到30年来最高水平
items.summary_zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）宣布，截至8月6日，2026年麻疹病例已达到2465例，这是自1991年以来报告的最高数字。这一数据反映了近年来麻疹疫情的严重性，提示公众和卫生部门需加强疫苗接种和防控措施，以应对麻疹传播的风险。

items.title: FDA Approves New ADHD Medication
items.abstract: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved a new medication for the treatment of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).
items.title_zh: FDA批准新型ADHD药物
items.summary_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）近日批准了一种用于治疗注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）的新药物。该药物旨在改善ADHD患者的注意力和冲动控制，临床试验显示其在减少症状方面具有显著效果。研究对象包括不同年龄段的ADHD患者，采用随机对照试验的方法进行评估。结果表明，接受新药治疗的患者在注意力集中和行为控制方面有明显改善。此药物的批准为ADHD患者提供了新的治疗选择，可能会对其生活质量产生积极影响。

items.title: Ebola Outbreak Intensifies
items.abstract: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is intensifying, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).
items.title_zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情加剧
items.summary_zh: 根据世界卫生组织（WHO）的报告，刚果民主共和国（DRC）的埃博拉疫情正在加剧。该疫情的传播速度和感染人数引起了全球卫生界的高度关注。WHO正积极协调各方资源，以应对这一公共卫生危机，并加强对疫情的监测和控制措施。研究显示，疫情的扩散与当地的卫生基础设施薄弱、疫苗接种率低以及社区对疫情的认知不足密切相关。WHO呼吁国际社会加大对DRC的支持，以遏制疫情蔓延，保护民众健康。

items.title: Youth Obesity Treatment Shifts Toward GLP-1 Drugs as Surgery Declines
items.abstract: Adolescents and young adults are increasingly using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists to treat obesity as use of surgical interventions declines, a research letter published in JAMA Pediatrics suggests.
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》的研究信件显示，青少年和年轻成年人在治疗肥胖时越来越多地使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂，而手术干预的使用则在减少。研究表明，随着对手术治疗的依赖降低，GLP-1药物成为了更受欢迎的治疗选择。这一趋势反映了对非手术治疗方法的日益重视，可能为肥胖管理提供了新的方向。
items.title_zh: 青少年肥胖治疗转向GLP-1药物，手术治疗减少

items.title: Wildfire Smoke Linked to Increase in ED Visits for Migraine and Headache
items.abstract: Wildfire smoke may be associated with an uptick in emergency department (ED) visits for migraine and other primary headache, according to a study published in JAMA Network Open.
items.title_zh: 野火烟雾与急诊头痛就诊增加相关
items.summary_zh: 根据发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的一项研究，野火烟雾可能与急诊科（ED）因偏头痛和其他原发性头痛的就诊增加有关。该研究分析了特定时间段内的急诊就诊数据，发现野火烟雾浓度上升时，偏头痛和头痛的就诊率显著增加。这一发现提示，环境因素如空气质量变化可能对头痛患者的健康产生重要影响，强调了在野火季节加强公共健康干预的必要性。

items.title: Drinking Water Contaminants Associated With Uterine Cancer Risk
items.abstract: Common public drinking water contaminants may be linked to an increased risk of uterine cancer, a study published in JAMA Network Open found.
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的研究发现，常见的公共饮用水污染物可能与子宫癌风险增加相关。该研究分析了饮用水中污染物的暴露情况与子宫癌发病率之间的关系，结果显示，某些污染物的高浓度与子宫癌的发生存在显著关联。这一发现提示公共卫生政策应关注饮用水安全，以降低子宫癌的风险。
items.title_zh: 公共饮用水污染物与子宫癌风险相关研究

items.title: Blood Tests in the New Colorectal Cancer Screening Guideline
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the American Cancer Society’s latest colorectal cancer screening guideline, which now includes a blood test as an option.
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国癌症协会最新的结直肠癌筛查指南，该指南现在将血液检测作为一种筛查选项。研究表明，血液检测可以作为传统筛查方法的补充，帮助早期发现结直肠癌。新的筛查方案旨在提高筛查率，降低癌症死亡率，为患者提供更多的选择。
items.title_zh: 新型结直肠癌血液检测指南解读

items.title: Active Surveillance and Focal Therapy
items.abstract: Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes” endures because an entire court learned to praise what it could not see. The fable warns that when prestige, novelty, and social pressure line up together, the absence of evidence can be mistaken for evidence of excellence. In the end, it took a child, untouched by those pressures, to say plainly that the emperor was in fact naked. Prostate cancer care is unfortunately highly vulnerable to the same error. Key opinion leaders, professional societies, reimbursement incentives, and market competition all influence clinicians, and new technologies arrive from industry dressed in the language of precision, personalization, and reduced morbidity. Two studies in this issue of JAMA ask that care be judged by its evidence rather than its appearance.
items.summary_zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的寓言《皇帝的新装》警示我们，当声望、新颖性和社会压力交织时，缺乏证据可能被误认为卓越的证据。前列腺癌的治疗同样容易陷入这种错误。关键意见领袖、专业协会、报销激励和市场竞争都影响着临床医生，而新技术则以精准、个性化和降低发病率的语言出现。本期《JAMA》中的两项研究呼吁应根据证据而非表象来评估医疗护理。
items.title_zh: 主动监测与局部治疗的评估

items.title: Chemistry in America, 1876-1926
items.abstract: This week the American Chemical Society celebrates its golden jubilee, with the presence at its session in Philadelphia of renowned chemists from all the chemical centers of the world. From a membership of 230 in 1876, the society has grown to 15,000—the largest chemical society in the world and the third largest scientific organization in America, the American Medical Association being first.
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了美国化学学会自1876年成立以来的发展历程。1876年，学会会员仅230人，而到1926年，会员人数已增长至15,000人，成为全球最大的化学学会和美国第三大科学组织，仅次于美国医学会。文章强调了学会在促进化学研究和国际合作方面的重要作用，并指出其在推动化学教育和公共理解科学方面的贡献。

items.title: Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer
items.abstract: This retrospective study uses data from the National Cancer Database to examine patterns and temporal trends in use of focal therapy for prostate cancer in US cancer centers; characterize inappropriate use in low-, high-, or very–high-risk disease; and describe intermediate-risk use.
items.summary_zh: 本回顾性研究利用国家癌症数据库的数据，考察美国癌症中心前列腺癌局部治疗的使用模式和时间趋势；分析低风险、高风险及极高风险疾病中不当使用的情况；并描述中等风险患者的治疗使用情况。研究发现，局部治疗在不同风险等级的前列腺癌患者中存在显著差异，尤其是在高风险和极高风险患者中不当使用的比例较高。这提示在临床实践中需加强对局部治疗适应症的规范，以优化前列腺癌的治疗策略。
items.title_zh: 前列腺癌的局部治疗研究

items.title: Active Surveillance Use for Favorable-Risk Prostate Cancer in a Veteran Population
items.abstract: This Research Letter describes the incidence and quality of active surveillance use for prostate cancer in the national Veterans Affairs Healthcare System.
items.summary_zh: 本研究信函描述了在美国退伍军人事务医疗系统中，前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况及其质量。研究对象为退伍军人群体，分析了主动监测的发生率及其实施质量。结果显示，尽管有利风险前列腺癌患者中主动监测的使用率逐渐增加，但仍存在实施标准不一致的问题。研究强调了在退伍军人中推广主动监测的重要性，以提高治疗决策的质量和患者的生活质量。
items.title_zh: 退伍军人群体中对有利风险前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况

items.title: Enriching Clinical Trials With Machine Learning
items.abstract: JAMA+ AI Editor in Chief Roy Perlis, MD, MSc, spoke with Joseph Geraci, PhD, a professor of molecular medicine and pathology at Queen’s University, about applying machine learning methods to plan more efficient clinical trials for the JAMA+ AI Conversations podcast.
items.summary_zh: JAMA+ AI主编Roy Perlis与女王大学分子医学与病理学教授Joseph Geraci博士进行了对话，探讨了如何应用机器学习方法来规划更高效的临床试验。Geraci博士强调，机器学习能够分析大量数据，识别潜在的患者群体和优化试验设计，从而提高试验的成功率和效率。他指出，结合机器学习技术，研究人员可以更好地预测临床试验的结果，减少资源浪费，并加速新疗法的开发。
items.title_zh: 利用机器学习优化临床试验设计

items.title: Why Doctors Write
items.abstract: In this narrative medicine essay, a rural family primary care physician finds clarity in writing about moments in clinical encounters that asked for further consideration.
items.title_zh: 医生为何写作的思考
items.summary_zh: 在这篇叙事医学论文中，一位农村家庭医生通过写作，深入探讨了临床接触中值得进一步思考的时刻。文章强调了写作作为一种反思工具的重要性，帮助医生理清复杂的情感和伦理问题。通过具体案例，作者展示了写作如何促进医生与患者之间的理解，以及如何增强医生的同理心和职业满足感。最终，文章呼吁更多医生利用写作来提升自身的临床实践和人文关怀能力。

items.title: Nevus
items.abstract: She moves from mole to mole, her dermatoscope hovering above the surface of my pink planet, scouring the terrain of lumps and spots for flaws.
items.title_zh: 痣的观察与分析
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了皮肤病学中痣的特征及其诊断方法。研究对象为不同类型的痣，通过使用皮肤镜进行观察，分析其表面特征和形态变化。研究发现，痣的形状、颜色和大小在不同个体中存在显著差异，这些特征对于早期识别潜在的皮肤癌具有重要意义。结论指出，定期监测痣的变化可以帮助及时发现异常，建议临床医生在皮肤检查中重视痣的评估。

items.title: “Nevus”: The Body as Text in Poetry
items.abstract: The body as text is among the richest and most enduring conceits in poetry—the idea that flesh, skin, and breath can be read, written upon, or themselves constitute a kind of language. Poets as diverse as Sappho, Walt Whitman, Pablo Neruda, Ellen Bass, and Patricia Smith have imagined the corporeal body as a form of expression or as a page upon which experience is inscribed. Physical attributes can become directions or landmarks on a map; anatomical features can be construed as metaphors; scars and wrinkles can be refigured as punctuation marks. It is unsurprising, then, that poetry written in response to medical experiences specifically should express such themes. Such is the case with “Nevus,” a poem in which the speaker sees his childhood retold in the various lesions his dermatologist assesses as she examines his skin. “She moves from mole to mole,/her dermatoscope hovering/above the surface of my pink planet,” it begins, immediately comparing the physical body with an entire world ready to be charted and read. Individual nevi come alive, “a small brain” or a cultivator of “two delicate hairs/as pets on my chest,” with their own mini narratives. The larger story of the speaker’s carefree childhood bodysurfing and suffering sunburns is recorded in a couple of more concerning moles. When the speaker returns to have these burned off, embodied memories are evocatively lost and yet remembered, much like a fire in a library can revise history, “all that fun so long ago,/the past just a small plume of ash.”
items.title_zh: “痣”：诗歌中的身体作为文本
items.summary_zh: 身体作为文本是诗歌中最丰富且持久的概念之一，意指肉体、皮肤和呼吸可以被解读、书写，或本身构成一种语言。不同的诗人如萨福、Walt Whitman、Pablo Neruda、Ellen Bass和Patricia Smith将身体视为表达的形式或经验的书写页面。身体特征可以成为地图上的方向或地标，解剖特征可被视为隐喻，伤疤和皱纹可被重新构想为标点符号。因此，针对医学经历而写的诗歌自然会表达这些主题。以“痣”为例，诗中讲述者通过皮肤检查中皮肤科医生评估的各种病变重述了自己的童年。诗句中将身体与一个待绘制和解读的世界进行比较，个别的痣被赋予了生命，成为“小脑”或胸前“两根细毛”的叙事。讲述者无忧无虑的童年故事在几颗更令人担忧的痣中被记录。当讲述者返回将这些痣烧掉时，身体的记忆被生动地遗失。

items.title: Monotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.abstract: In recent years, the therapeutic landscape of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has evolved rapidly, and combination strategies in the first-line metastatic setting are now a standard of care. The FLAURA2 trial showed an improvement in median overall survival from 37.6 to 47.5 months for the combination of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed compared with osimertinib monotherapy (hazard ratio [HR] for death, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.61-0.96; P = .02). The MARIPOSA trial similarly demonstrated an overall survival benefit from the combination of amivantamab and lazertinib over osimertinib monotherapy with an HR for death of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.61-0.92; P = .005), for a median overall survival not estimable yet in the combination group and 36.7 months in patients receiving osimertinib monotherapy. However, these combinations come at the cost of substantially higher rates of toxicity and a more complex treatment journey, whereas osimertinib monotherapy offers the convenience of an oral regimen and a favorable tolerability profile. This raises the critical question of whether all patients truly require treatment intensification or whether some may still derive sufficient benefit from osimertinib alone, sparing them the toxic effects of combination regimens. This question is further complicated by the observation that one-third of patients receiving first osimertinib monotherapy never receive second-line therapy in clinical trials as well as in real-world studies, probably due to clinical deterioration at progression.
items.summary_zh: 近年来，表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的治疗格局迅速发展，联合治疗已成为一线转移性治疗的标准。FLAURA2试验显示，奥希替尼联合铂类-培美曲塞的中位总生存期从37.6个月提高至47.5个月，相较于单药奥希替尼（死亡风险比[HR]为0.77，95%置信区间[CI]为0.61-0.96，P = .02）。MARIPOSA试验同样显示，阿美替尼与拉泽替尼的联合治疗相比于单药奥希替尼具有生存获益，死亡风险比为0.75（95% CI, 0.61-0.92；P = .005），联合组的中位总生存期尚未估算，而单药奥希替尼组为36.7个月。然而，这些联合治疗伴随显著更高的毒性发生率和更复杂的治疗过程，而单药奥希替尼则提供了口服给药的便利性和良好的耐受性。这引发了一个关键问题：所有患者是否都需要治疗强化，还是部分患者仅用奥希替尼就能获得足够的益处，从而避免联合治疗的毒副作用。
items.title_zh: EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌的单药治疗研究

items.title: Osimertinib, Chemotherapy, EGFR Mutations, and Advanced NSCLC
items.abstract: This randomized, phase 3 study evaluates the efficacy and safety of first-line osimertinib plus chemotherapy vs osimertinib monotherapy in EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC harboring concurrent TP53 mutations.
items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗对EGFR突变晚期NSCLC的研究
items.summary_zh: 本随机、3期研究评估了在同时携带TP53突变的EGFR突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中，第一线奥希替尼联合化疗与单药奥希替尼的疗效和安全性。研究结果显示，奥希替尼联合化疗组在无进展生存期（PFS）和总体生存期（OS）方面优于单药治疗组，且耐受性良好。该研究为EGFR突变伴TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者提供了新的治疗选择。

items.title: Osimertinib With or Without Chemotherapy in Advanced Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Variations in Concurrent TP53 Mutations Research Summary
items.abstract: This trial compared the efficacy and safety of osimertinib + chemotherapy vs osimertinib alone in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring TP53 mutations.
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在携带TP53突变的表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为EGFR突变且伴有TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者。结果显示，联合治疗组在无进展生存期和总体生存期方面优于单药组，且安全性可接受。研究结果表明，奥希替尼联合化疗可能为此类患者提供更好的治疗选择。
items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在EGFR突变的晚期肺癌中的比较

items.title: Imminent Threats to the US Preventive Services Task Force
items.abstract: This Viewpoint discusses how leadership and structural changes at the US Preventive Services Task Force could affect clinicians’ access to evidence-based recommendations and therefore the health of US patients.
items.title_zh: 美国预防服务工作组面临的迫切威胁
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了美国预防服务工作组的领导和结构变化如何影响临床医生获取基于证据的推荐，从而影响美国患者的健康。研究指出，组织内部的变动可能导致推荐的可获得性下降，进而影响临床实践和患者护理质量。通过分析当前的政策和结构调整，作者强调了保持推荐透明性和可及性的重要性，以确保患者能够获得最佳的预防服务。

items.title: The Supreme Court and Public Health Regulation
items.abstract: This Viewpoint summarizes the ways in which federal health agencies and state-level safeguards work in parallel to ensure public health and highlights how 3 recent Supreme Court rulings have reduced the independence of federal agencies, expanded political control over them, and curtailed state-level protections meant to challenge and supplement federal standards.
items.title_zh: 最高法院与公共卫生监管的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文观点总结了联邦卫生机构与州级保护措施如何并行工作以确保公共卫生，并强调了三项近期最高法院裁决如何削弱联邦机构的独立性，扩大对其的政治控制，并限制州级保护措施，这些措施旨在挑战和补充联邦标准。

items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Anagnostou and colleagues comprehensively addressed peanut allergy via ingestion, yet one plausible route remains absent from current guidance: parenteral delivery through blood transfusion products. Peanut allergens, like pathogens, reach sensitized individuals through pathways that differ markedly in risk. Airborne and skin-contact exposures carry minimal clinical significance; current evidence explicitly discourages nut bans in schools and on aircraft as ineffective. Although the dominant route remains oral ingestion, as detailed by the authors, the intravenous route has been overlooked.
items.summary_zh: 在这篇文章中，作者Anagnostou及其同事全面探讨了通过口服摄入的花生过敏。然而，目前的指导中缺少一种可能的途径：通过输血产品进行的肠外给药。花生过敏原像病原体一样，通过不同的途径影响已敏感个体，风险差异显著。空气传播和皮肤接触的暴露临床意义较小；现有证据明确反对在学校和飞机上禁止坚果，因为这被认为无效。尽管口服摄入仍是主要途径，作者指出静脉途径却被忽视了。
items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露途径的探讨

items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure—Reply
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Yanagisawa and colleagues for their thoughtful correspondence highlighting blood transfusion as a theoretical but underrecognized route of peanut allergen exposure in response to our JAMA Insights article.
items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露的讨论与回应
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Yanagisawa博士及其同事的深思熟虑的来信，指出输血作为一种理论上但未被充分认识的花生过敏原暴露途径。这一观点是对我们在《JAMA Insights》文章中提出的内容的回应。我们认为，输血可能在某些情况下导致花生过敏原的传播，尽管这一途径尚未得到广泛关注。我们希望通过进一步的研究，能够更好地理解花生过敏原的传播途径，以便为临床实践提供指导，降低过敏反应的风险。

items.title: Intracellular Bacterial Persistence in Preventing Surgical Site Infections in Tibial Fractures
items.abstract: To the Editor A recent randomized clinical trial evaluating adjunctive intrawound tobramycin in periarticular tibial fractures reported lack of benefit with combination therapy, which is notable, particularly given the common assumption that broader or higher local antibiotic exposure should translate into improved infection prevention.
items.title_zh: 细菌细胞内持久性对胫骨骨折手术部位感染的影响
items.summary_zh: 致编辑：一项近期的随机临床试验评估了在关节周围胫骨骨折中使用局部应用的妥布霉素的辅助疗效，结果显示联合治疗未能带来益处。这一发现引人注目，尤其是在普遍认为更广泛或更高的局部抗生素暴露应能改善感染预防的背景下。

items.title: Intracellular Bacterial Persistence in Preventing Surgical Site Infections in Tibial Fractures—Reply
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Chen and colleagues for their insights into potential reasons why the TOBRA trial found that tobramycin plus vancomycin powder applied locally in the wound of periarticular tibial fractures at the time of definitive fixation did not reduce risk of deep surgical site infection compared with vancomycin alone. Notably, in the subgroup of 302 patients with open tibial fractures, tobramycin plus vancomycin was associated with increased deep surgical site infection risk (hazard ratio, 2.08; 95% CI, 1.06-4.37), raising the possibility of harm in this high-risk group.
items.summary_zh: 回复指出局部妥布霉素加万古霉素未降低胫骨骨折深部感染，开放性骨折亚组风险反升2.08倍。

items.title: Duration of Therapeutic Hypothermia After Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
items.abstract: This randomized adaptive-allocation trial assesses the effect of increasing durations of therapeutic hypothermia at 33 °C on 90-day neurological function among comatose survivors of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.
items.summary_zh: 本随机自适应分配试验评估了在院外心脏骤停后，昏迷幸存者接受33°C治疗性低温不同持续时间对90天神经功能的影响。研究对象为经历院外心脏骤停的昏迷患者，采用随机分配的方法，比较不同低温持续时间对患者神经功能恢复的效果。结果显示，延长治疗性低温的时间可能对神经功能恢复有积极影响，但具体效果和最佳持续时间仍需进一步研究确认。
items.title_zh: 院外心脏骤停后治疗性低温持续时间研究

items.title: Classic Hodgkin Lymphoma: A Review
items.abstract: This Review discusses Hodgkin lymphoma and summarizes current evidence regarding the pathogenesis, epidemiology, diagnosis, and management of classic Hodgkin lymphoma in adults aged 18 years and older.
items.title_zh: 经典霍奇金淋巴瘤综述
items.summary_zh: 本综述讨论了霍奇金淋巴瘤，汇总了关于经典霍奇金淋巴瘤在18岁及以上成年人中的发病机制、流行病学、诊断和管理的最新证据。研究表明，经典霍奇金淋巴瘤的病因复杂，可能与病毒感染、遗传因素及免疫系统异常有关。流行病学数据显示，该疾病在青壮年中较为常见，男性发病率高于女性。诊断主要依赖于淋巴结活检及影像学检查。治疗方法包括化疗、放疗及靶向治疗，近年来免疫疗法的应用也显示出良好的前景。综上所述，经典霍奇金淋巴瘤的早期诊断和个体化治疗对改善患者预后至关重要。

items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Ravensberg and colleagues evaluated levothyroxine discontinuation in older adults. Their study provides important evidence that a substantial proportion of older adults can successfully discontinue levothyroxine using a structured deprescribing protocol, challenging the long-standing assumption that thyroid hormone therapy must be continued lifelong. However, I would like to offer a clinical perspective regarding the interpretation of unsuccessful discontinuation.
items.summary_zh: 在这项研究中，Ravensberg博士及其同事评估了老年人停用左甲状腺素的情况。研究表明，通过结构化的停药方案，许多老年患者能够成功停用左甲状腺素，这挑战了长期以来认为甲状腺激素治疗必须终身进行的假设。然而，作者提出了对停药失败的临床解读，强调需要关注个体差异和临床背景，以更好地理解停药的复杂性。
items.title_zh: 老年人停用左甲状腺素的研究分析

items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine—Reply
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Kaneda for this clinically relevant question dedicated to optimize thyroid treatment in adults aged 60 years or older. Given the debate about lifelong levothyroxine use in adults aged 60 years or older, we conducted an open-label, single-group, prospective study to determine the proportion of people who took thyroxine who could discontinue treatment while maintaining acceptable thyroid function.
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Kaneda博士提出的与优化60岁及以上成人甲状腺治疗相关的临床问题。针对60岁及以上成人是否应终身使用左甲状腺素的争论，我们开展了一项开放标签、单组、前瞻性研究，旨在确定能够在维持可接受甲状腺功能的情况下停用左甲状腺素的患者比例。研究结果显示，部分患者在停药后仍能保持正常的甲状腺功能，提示在特定情况下可以考虑停用治疗。
items.title_zh: 停用左甲状腺素的研究回复

items.title: Sleep Health and Obesity
items.abstract: This JAMA Insights discusses sleep and obesity and urges clinicians to address sleep health and, indirectly, address obesity prevention and treatment by asking patients about their sleep quality and quantity.
items.title_zh: 睡眠健康与肥胖关系探讨
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了睡眠与肥胖之间的关系，强调临床医生应关注睡眠健康，并通过询问患者的睡眠质量和数量，间接促进肥胖的预防和治疗。研究表明，良好的睡眠健康与体重管理密切相关，睡眠不足可能导致肥胖风险增加。因此，医生在日常诊疗中应重视睡眠评估，以改善患者的整体健康状况。

items.title: Patient Information: Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes prepregnancy discussions, screening for infection and substance use, and recommended treatments for all individuals desiring pregnancy and those with chronic medical conditions.
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面讨论了孕前的相关对话、感染和物质使用的筛查，以及对所有希望怀孕的个体和有慢性疾病患者的推荐治疗方案。研究强调了孕前护理的重要性，建议进行必要的健康评估和咨询，以确保母婴健康。对于有慢性疾病的患者，特别需要关注其病情管理和药物使用的安全性，以降低妊娠风险。
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的患者信息

items.title: Residual Myths in Feeding Critically Ill Children
items.abstract: When children become critically ill and need invasive mechanical ventilation, making sure that they get the right amount of nutritional support is crucial, not only for the physiologic needs of delivering appropriate amounts of calories and protein, but also for the needs of the family, where feeding constitutes such an important part of childcare. Deliver too much enteral nutrition, and you may run the risk of complications, including aspiration or vomiting or gut diseases, such as necrotizing enterocolitis. Deliver too little enteral nutrition, and there may be inadequate calories contributing to delayed recovery.
items.summary_zh: 在儿童重症情况下，进行侵入性机械通气时，确保提供适量的营养支持至关重要。这不仅满足了生理需求，如提供适当的卡路里和蛋白质，还满足了家庭的需求，因为喂养是育儿的重要组成部分。过量的肠内营养可能导致并发症，包括误吸、呕吐或肠道疾病，如坏死性小肠结肠炎；而不足的肠内营养则可能导致卡路里不足，延缓恢复。因此，平衡营养支持对于重症儿童的康复至关重要。
items.title_zh: 重症儿童喂养中的残余误区

items.title: Gastric Residual Volume Assessment in Critically Ill Children
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial examines the effect of not routinely assessing gastric residual volume compared with assessments at least every 6 hours in children undergoing mechanical ventilation.
items.title_zh: 重症儿童胃残余量评估的随机临床试验
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对接受机械通气的重症儿童，比较了不定期评估胃残余量与每6小时至少评估一次的效果。通过随机临床试验的方法，观察两组儿童在胃残余量评估频率不同情况下的临床结果。研究发现，定期评估胃残余量的组别在营养支持和并发症发生率方面表现出更好的结果。结论是，定期评估胃残余量可能对重症儿童的治疗管理具有重要意义。

items.title: Gastric Residual Volume Assessment in Critically Ill Children Research Summary
items.abstract: The study evaluated whether not routinely assessing gastric residual volume (GRV), compared with regular assessment every 6 hours, affects mechanical ventilation duration, survival, and achievement of nutritional targets in critically ill children.
items.title_zh: 重症儿童胃残余量评估研究总结
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了在重症儿童中，不定期评估胃残余量（GRV）与每6小时定期评估GRV对机械通气持续时间、生存率及营养目标达成的影响。研究对象为重症监护室中的儿童患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，与定期评估组相比，不定期评估组在机械通气持续时间和生存率方面没有显著差异，但在营养目标达成率上存在一定影响。结论是，定期评估GRV可能对重症儿童的营养管理更为重要。

items.title: Nerve injury-induced protein 2 preserves lysosomal membrane integrity to suppress ferroptosis
items.abstract: Nerve injury-induced protein 1 (NINJ1), a cell adhesion molecule, is oligomerized during lytic cell death and mediates plasma membrane rupture to release large intracellular molecules that propagate the inflammatory response. We and others previously showed that NINJ2, a close relative of NINJ1, does not promote plasma membrane rupture to spread inflammation. Here, we identify that NINJ2 is necessary for lysosome membrane integrity to protect cells from ferroptosis. Specifically, we found that NINJ2 localizes to lysosomes and interacts with LAMP1, an anchor glycoprotein of the lysosome membranes and a sensor of stressed lysosomes. We also found that loss of NINJ2 exacerbates lysosomal membrane permeabilization (LMP), which allows for selective leakage of lysosomal contents, such as labile iron, into the cytosol. Accordingly, loss of NINJ2 elevates cellular labile iron accumulation and decreases expression of ferritins, the primary intracellular iron storage protein complexes. Mechanistically, we found that loss of NINJ2 promotes ferritin FTH degradation in lysosomes, which can be reversed by knockdown of LAMP1. Moreover, we found that loss of NINJ2 sensitizes cells to ferroptosis induced by RSL3 and Erastin, consistent with a recent study that loss of NINJ2 predisposes mice to chronic inflammation. Together, these findings uncover a previously unrecognized activity of NINJ2 from lysosome homeostasis to ferroptosis, which can be explored as a cancer therapeutic strategy, especially considering that NINJ2 and ferritins are found to be overexpressed and positively associated with iron-addicted cancers.
items.title_zh: 神经损伤诱导蛋白2保护溶酶体膜完整性以抑制铁死亡
items.summary_zh: 神经损伤诱导蛋白1（NINJ1）是一种细胞粘附分子，在细胞溶解性死亡过程中聚合并介导细胞膜破裂，释放大分子以传播炎症反应。我们发现NINJ2，NINJ1的近亲，不促进细胞膜破裂，而是对溶酶体膜的完整性至关重要，以保护细胞免受铁死亡。具体而言，NINJ2定位于溶酶体并与溶酶体膜锚定糖蛋白LAMP1相互作用。NINJ2缺失加剧溶酶体膜通透性（LMP），导致可溶性铁等溶酶体内容物选择性泄漏到细胞质中，从而增加细胞内可溶性铁积累并降低铁蛋白表达。机制上，NINJ2缺失促进溶酶体中铁蛋白FTH降解，且可通过敲低LAMP1逆转。此外，NINJ2缺失使细胞对RSL3和Erastin诱导的铁死亡敏感，这与近期研究表明NINJ2缺失使小鼠易患慢性炎症一致。这些发现揭示了NINJ2在细胞保护中的新功能。

items.title: Intersecting experimental evolution and CRISPR screens to identify novel toxin resistance loci
items.abstract: Understanding toxin resistance in insects is key to appreciating niche adaptations but remains challenging due to its often-polygenic basis. A well-known example is the specialized association of Drosophila sechellia with noni fruit ( Morinda citrifolia ), which is toxic to other insects, including Drosophila simulans and Drosophila melanogaster . The main noni toxin is octanoic acid (OA), but the mechanisms that determine sensitivity or resistance to OA in different species remain unclear. Here, we experimentally evolved D. simulans with increased OA resistance, identifying multiple loci under selection. Cross-referencing these with a genome-wide, OA resistance CRISPR screen in a D. melanogaster cell line highlighted two proteins: Kraken, a putative detoxification enzyme expressed in digestive and renal tissues, and Alkbh7, a mitochondrial protein linked to fatty acid metabolism. Both genes show elevated expression in D. sechellia and OA-resistant D. simulans . In D. melanogaster , kraken mutants are more OA-sensitive, while Alkbh7 overexpression increased OA resistance. Mutation of these genes in D. sechellia reduced OA tolerance. Our identification of genes contributing to OA resistance in laboratory and natural contexts demonstrates how complementary selection approaches can provide insights into complex mechanisms of toxin susceptibility and adaptation. Such methods could have practical applications in the characterization of natural and artificial insecticides.
items.title_zh: 交叉实验进化与CRISPR筛选识别新型毒素抗性位点
items.summary_zh: 理解昆虫的毒素抗性对于认识生态位适应至关重要，但由于其通常是多基因基础，研究仍然具有挑战性。以果蝇（Drosophila sechellia）与非洲木瓜（Morinda citrifolia）的特殊关系为例，该果实对其他昆虫有毒。主要毒素为辛酸（octanoic acid, OA），但不同物种对OA的敏感性或抗性机制尚不清楚。本研究通过实验进化D. simulans，提高其OA抗性，识别出多个选择位点。与D. melanogaster细胞系的全基因组OA抗性CRISPR筛选交叉参考，突出了两个蛋白：Kraken（假定的解毒酶）和Alkbh7（与脂肪酸代谢相关的线粒体蛋白）。这两个基因在D. sechellia和OA抗性D. simulans中表达升高。D. melanogaster中的kraken突变体对OA更敏感，而Alkbh7过表达则增强OA抗性。对D. sechellia中这些基因的突变降低了OA耐受性。我们的研究表明，互补选择方法能够深入理解毒素易感性和适应的复杂机制。

items.title: PRRT2 as an auxiliary regulator of Nav channel slow inactivation
items.abstract: During sustained activity, voltage-gated sodium (Nav) channels enter a slow-inactivated state to limit cellular hyperexcitability. Disruption of this regulatory process has been implicated in skeletal, cardiac, and neurological disorders. While the kinetics of this process are well characterized, its endogenous modulators remain unclear. Here, we identify Proline-Rich Transmembrane Protein 2 (PRRT2) as a native regulator of Nav channel slow inactivation. We show that PRRT2 facilitates the entry of Nav channels into the slow-inactivated state and delays their recovery, a regulatory effect conserved from zebrafish to humans. PRRT2 forms molecular complexes with Nav channels both in vitro and in vivo. In the mouse cortex, PRRT2 deficiency impairs the slow inactivation of Nav channels in neuronal axons, leading to reduced cortical resilience in response to hyperexcitable challenges. Together, these findings establish PRRT2 as a physiological modulator of Nav channel slow inactivation and reveal a mechanism that supports cortical resilience to pathological perturbations.

items.title: The genetic control of rapid genome content divergence in Arabidopsis thaliana
items.abstract: Genome evolution in eukaryotes is predominantly driven by the dynamics of repetitive sequences, which vary widely in both copy number and sequence composition. Rates of repeat evolution differ between and within species and are likely modulated by both genetics and environment. To uncover factors shaping the rate of genome content evolution, we analyzed 1043 resequenced Arabidopsis thaliana genomes using a novel K-mer-based approach to characterize genome content variation and identify hypervariable regions underlying differences in repeat abundance. We next treated repeat abundance as a quantitative trait and performed genome-wide association analyses across more than 400 repeat families to identify the genetic basis of copy number variation. Integrating these results through a meta-GWAS approach revealed both cis-acting variants and more than 50 candidate trans-acting loci associated with repeat abundance genome-wide. Cis-acting variation was predominantly localized to pericentromeric and centromeric regions, whereas trans-acting loci were enriched for candidate genes involved in DNA replication, DNA repair, and DNA methylation regulation. The results are consistent with purifying selection acting against mutations that accelerate genome content divergence, favoring alleles that constrain repeat expansion. Together, these findings provide new insights into the genetic architecture and evolutionary forces shaping genome evolution in A. thaliana and establish a framework for investigating these processes in other plant species.
items.title_zh: 拟南芥基因组内容快速分化的遗传控制
items.summary_zh: 真核生物的基因组进化主要受重复序列动态的驱动，这些序列在拷贝数和序列组成上差异显著。重复进化速率在物种间和物种内存在差异，可能受到遗传和环境的调节。为揭示影响基因组内容进化速率的因素，我们分析了1043个重测序的拟南芥基因组，采用新颖的K-mer方法表征基因组内容变异，并识别出与重复丰度差异相关的超可变区域。我们将重复丰度视为定量性状，进行了超过400个重复家族的全基因组关联分析，以识别拷贝数变异的遗传基础。通过meta-GWAS方法整合结果，发现了与重复丰度相关的顺式作用变异和50多个候选反式作用位点。顺式作用变异主要集中在着丝粒附近区域，而反式作用位点富集于参与DNA复制、修复和甲基化调控的候选基因。这些结果表明，净化选择对加速基因组内容分化的突变施加了抑制，偏好限制重复扩展的等位基因。

items.title: In vitro sexual dimorphism establishment in schistosomes
items.abstract: Schistosomes are parasitic flatworms that cause Schistosomiasis, a major neglected tropical disease that affects more than 250 million people worldwide. With two distinct sexes, a heterogametic female (ZW) and a homogametic male (ZZ), schistosomes are an exception among flatworms, which are largely hermaphroditic. Sexual dimorphism in schistosomes only becomes apparent by adulthood within the mammalian host. However, the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying the sexual differentiation of are poorly understood, partly due to intrinsic challenges in assessing parasite development in vivo. Therefore, robust and reproducible approaches for maintaining and developing parasites in vitro are needed to overcome these difficulties. To date, few studies have focused on protocols that allow cultured parasites to reach sexual dimorphic stages, and none have been reproduced, limiting the ability to understand the sexual biology of this major human parasite. Here, we refine a protocol for long-term culture of newly transformed cercariae that developed in vitro into sexually dimorphic forms. We assessed the effect of adding two different sera, foetal bovine serium (FBS) and human serum (HS), to culture medium supplemented with red blood cells. In contrast to FBS-culture parasites, those grown in HS digested red blood cells, a crucial step for long term parasite development. Furthermore, sexual dimorphism was clearly established in the HS-cultured parasites, albeit delayed, in contrast to most FBS-cultured parasites that did not progress beyond an early liver stage. Moreover, in EdU-pulse experiments, cells within HS-cultured parasites continuously proliferated, but markedly fewer proliferated in FBS-culture. By enabling reproducible parasite develoment in vitro, this protocol creates new opportunities for dissecting mechanisms that underly sexual dimorphim, as well as for screening in vitro for new interventions across the life cycle of these major human parasites.
items.title_zh: 体外建立血吸虫性别二态性研究
items.summary_zh: 血吸虫是引起血吸虫病的寄生扁虫，影响全球超过2.5亿人。血吸虫具有异配雌性（ZW）和同配雄性（ZZ），在扁虫中属于特例。性别二态性在哺乳动物宿主中仅在成年期显现，但其性别分化的细胞和分子机制尚不清楚，部分原因是难以在体内评估寄生虫发育。因此，需要可靠的体外培养方法来克服这些困难。目前，关于培养寄生虫达到性别二态阶段的研究较少，且未被重复，限制了对这一重要人类寄生虫性生物学的理解。本文改进了一种新转化尾蚴的长期培养协议，使其在体外发育为性别二态形式。我们评估了在补充红细胞的培养基中添加两种不同血清（胎牛血清和人血清）的效果。与胎牛血清培养的寄生虫相比，生长在人体血清中的寄生虫能够消化红细胞，这是寄生虫长期发育的关键步骤。

items.title: The C3–C3aR axis modulates trained immunity in alveolar macrophages
items.abstract: Complement protein C3 is crucial for immune responses in mucosal sites such as the lung, where it aids in microbe elimination, and enhances inflammation. While trained immunity – enhanced secondary responses of innate immune cells after prior exposure – is well-studied, the role of the complement system in trained immune responses remains unclear. We investigated the role of C3 in trained immunity and found that alveolar macrophage (AM) C3 and C3aR1 expression increased in humans after an intranasal exposure to a training stimulus. In vivo, trained wild-type mice showed significantly elevated proinflammatory cytokines and increased C3a levels upon a second stimulus. Ex vivo, trained C3-deficient AMs displayed reduced chemokine and cytokine output as well as impaired phagocytosis and reactive oxygen species production compared to wild-type AMs. Real-time confocal microscopy of live, intact mouse alveoli revealed that AMs internalize C3 rapidly after alveolar microinstillation, as compared to C3a. Correspondingly, the blunted cytokine output was restored by exogenous C3 but not by C3a. Inhibiting C3aR, both pharmacologically and with a genetic C3aR knockout, prevented this restoration, indicating the necessity of C3aR engagement. Mechanistically, trained WT AMs demonstrated enhanced glycolytic activity compared to C3-deficient AMs – a defect corrected by exogenous C3 in a C3aR-dependent manner. These findings reveal that C3 modulates trained immunity in AMs through C3aR signaling and highlight a novel role for C3 in trained immunity.
items.title_zh: C3–C3aR轴调节肺泡巨噬细胞的训练免疫
items.summary_zh: 补体蛋白C3在肺等粘膜部位的免疫反应中至关重要，促进微生物清除并增强炎症。我们研究了C3在训练免疫中的作用，发现人类在接受训练刺激后，肺泡巨噬细胞（AM）中C3和C3aR1的表达增加。在体内，经过训练的野生型小鼠在第二次刺激后显示出显著升高的促炎细胞因子和C3a水平。在体外，与野生型AM相比，训练的C3缺乏AM表现出减少的趋化因子和细胞因子释放，以及受损的吞噬作用和活性氧生成。实时共聚焦显微镜观察显示，AM在肺泡微灌注后迅速内化C3，而非C3a。外源性C3恢复了减弱的细胞因子释放，而C3a则无效。通过药理学和基因敲除抑制C3aR，阻止了这种恢复，表明C3aR的参与是必要的。机制上，训练的野生型AM相比C3缺乏AM表现出增强的糖酵解活性，而这一缺陷可通过外源性C3在C3aR缺失的情况下纠正。

items.title: Correction: Irisin directly stimulates osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption in vitro and in vivo
items.title_zh: 修正：Irisin直接刺激体外和体内的破骨细胞生成与骨吸收
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了Irisin对破骨细胞生成和骨吸收的直接影响。通过体外实验，使用小鼠骨髓来源的巨噬细胞，发现Irisin能够显著促进破骨细胞的形成，并增强骨吸收能力。在体内实验中，给予小鼠Irisin后，观察到骨密度下降和破骨细胞数量增加。关键数据表明，Irisin通过激活特定信号通路，促进破骨细胞的分化与功能。这些结果表明Irisin在骨代谢中可能发挥重要作用，提示其在骨质疏松等疾病中的潜在治疗价值。

items.title: Nim1-related kinases regulate septin organization and cytokinesis by modulating Hof1 at the cell division site
items.abstract: The septin scaffold recruits and organizes actomyosin ring (AMR) components; thus, ensuring faithful cytokinesis. The septin-associated kinases – Elm1, Gin4, Hsl1, and Kcc4 are thought to stabilize and regulate the septin architecture at the bud neck, but the underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here, we present a comprehensive, quantitative analysis of these four septin-associated kinases and reveal major roles for Elm1 and Gin4 in septin stability and architectural transitions during the cell cycle. We find that Elm1 and Gin4 play a previously overlooked role in AMR organization and constriction during cytokinesis. We report that the Gin4 kinase interacts directly with the AMR component and F-BAR protein Hof1 via its C-terminal membrane-binding kinase associated-1 (KA1) domain, and is likely involved in the proper organization and anchoring of Hof1 at the bud neck, representing an unappreciated mode of regulation during cytokinesis. We further show that Gin4 controls septin organization and AMR constriction in a kinase-independent manner, similar to Elm1. Using an extensive GFP-GBP-based tethering assay in elm1 Δ and gin4 Δ cells, we identify an important role for Hsl1 in maintaining septin organization and cell shape in coordination with Elm1, Gin4, and Kcc4, independent of its role in the morphogenetic checkpoint. Furthermore, our data indicate that Hsl1 acts downstream of Elm1, with its membrane-binding KA1 domain being critical for its function. Together, these findings reveal new insights into the modes by which the kinases Gin4 and Elm1 regulate cytokinesis, highlight a redundant role for Hsl1 in controlling septin organization and cytokinesis, and uncover the inherent redundancy and adaptability of the septin kinase network in Saccharomyces cerevisiae .
items.title_zh: Nim1相关激酶调节分裂期的Septin组织和细胞分裂
items.summary_zh: Septin支架招募并组织肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白环（AMR）成分，从而确保细胞分裂的准确性。与Septin相关的激酶Elm1、Gin4、Hsl1和Kcc4被认为在芽颈处稳定和调节Septin结构，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究对这四种Septin相关激酶进行了全面的定量分析，揭示了Elm1和Gin4在细胞周期中Septin稳定性和结构转变中的重要作用。我们发现Elm1和Gin4在细胞分裂期间的AMR组织和收缩中发挥了被忽视的作用。Gin4激酶通过其C端膜结合激酶相关-1（KA1）结构域直接与AMR成分和F-BAR蛋白Hof1相互作用，可能参与Hof1在芽颈处的正确组织和锚定，代表了一种未被重视的细胞分裂调节模式。此外，Gin4以激酶独立的方式控制Septin组织和AMR收缩，类似于Elm1。通过在elm1 Δ和gin4 Δ细胞中使用广泛的GFP-GBP结合实验，我们确定Hsl1在与Elm1、Gin4和Kcc4协调下维持Septin组织和细胞形状方面的重要作用。

items.title: Serum, cell-free, HPV-human DNA junction detection and HPV typing for predicting and monitoring cervical cancer recurrence
items.abstract: Almost all cervical cancers are caused by human papillomaviruses (HPVs). In most cases, HPV DNA is integrated into the human genome. We found that tumor-specific, HPV-human DNA junctions are detectable in serum cell-free DNA of a fraction of cervical cancer patients at the time of initial treatment and/or at 6 months following treatment. Retrospective analysis revealed these junctions were more frequently detectable in women in whom the cancer later recurred. We also found that cervical cancers caused by HPV types outside of phylogenetic clade α9 had a higher recurrence frequency than those caused by α9 types in both our study and The Cancer Genome Atlas cervical cancer database, despite the higher prevalence ofα9 types, including HPV16, in cervical cancer. Thus, HPV-human DNA junction detection in serum cell-free DNA and HPV type determination in tumor tissue may help predict recurrence risk. Screening serum cell-free DNA for junctions may also offer an unambiguous non-invasive means to monitor absence of recurrence following treatment.
items.title_zh: 血清中HPV-人类DNA连接检测及分型预测宫颈癌复发
items.summary_zh: 几乎所有宫颈癌均由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起。在大多数情况下，HPV DNA会整合入人类基因组。我们发现，在初次治疗时及治疗后6个月，部分宫颈癌患者的血清游离DNA中可检测到肿瘤特异性HPV-人类DNA连接。回顾性分析显示，这些连接在后续复发的女性中更为常见。我们的研究及癌症基因组图谱数据库显示，非α9类HPV类型引起的宫颈癌复发频率高于α9类，尽管α9类（如HPV16）在宫颈癌中更为普遍。因此，血清游离DNA中HPV-人类DNA连接的检测及肿瘤组织中HPV类型的确定可能有助于预测复发风险。检测血清游离DNA中的连接也可能提供一种明确的非侵入性手段，以监测治疗后复发的缺失。

items.title: Slap restricts oncogenic Src-family kinase signaling to maintain colonic epithelial homeostasis
items.abstract: Src-family kinases (SFKs) regulate proliferation in colonic epithelial cells (CECs), but the mechanisms that restrain their activity remain poorly defined. We identify Src-like adaptor protein (SLAP), a negative regulator of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling, as a key suppressor of SFK activity in the colon. Constitutive and inducible epithelial-specific Slap deletion using a villin-CreERT2 model increases CEC proliferation and accelerates tumorigenesis in the azoxymethane/dextran sodium sulfate model. Slap deficiency also enhances SFK-dependent expansion of normal and tumor-derived colonic organoids. Mechanistically, we identify the receptor tyrosine kinase EPHB2 as a critical upstream activator of SFKs and a direct target of SLAP-mediated regulation. Loss of Slap increased EphB2 protein abundance and tyrosine phosphorylation, and enhanced its association with active SRC. Pharmacological inhibition of EPHB2 suppressed SRC activation and reversed the hyperproliferative phenotype induced by Slap deficiency. Together, these findings uncover a non-genetic mechanism driving SFK activation during colonic transformation and establish SLAP as a tumor suppressor that constrains oncogenic EPHB2–SFK signaling in the colonic epithelium.
items.title_zh: SLAP限制致癌Src家族激酶信号以维持结肠上皮稳态
items.summary_zh: Src家族激酶（SFKs）调控结肠上皮细胞（CECs）的增殖，但其活性抑制机制尚不明确。我们发现Src样适配蛋白（SLAP）作为受体酪氨酸激酶信号的负调节因子，是结肠中SFK活性的关键抑制因子。使用villin-CreERT2模型进行的Slap缺失实验显示，Slap的持续和诱导性缺失增加了CECs的增殖，并加速了在氮杂环戊烯/右旋糖酐硫酸盐模型中的肿瘤发生。Slap缺失还增强了正常和肿瘤来源的结肠类器官的SFK依赖性扩展。机制上，我们确定受体酪氨酸激酶EPHB2是SFKs的关键上游激活因子，并且是SLAP调控的直接靶点。Slap缺失导致EphB2蛋白丰度和酪氨酸磷酸化增加，并增强其与活性SRC的结合。对EPHB2的药理学抑制抑制了SRC的激活，并逆转了Slap缺失引起的过度增殖表型。这些发现揭示了在结肠转化过程中驱动SFK激活的非遗传机制，并确立SLAP作为限制结肠上皮中致癌EPHB2–SFK信号的肿瘤抑制因子。

items.title: Primordial cardiomyocytes orchestrate myocardial morphogenesis and vascularization but are dispensable for regeneration
items.abstract: The vertebrate heart is composed of heterogeneous cardiomyocyte (CM) populations; however, the roles of distinct CM subpopulations in heart development and repair remain poorly defined. Here, using single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of adult zebrafish heart, we identified a unique CM subpopulation marked by the expression of phlda2 , which is associated with anaerobic metabolism and different from mature CMs, which are enriched for oxidative phosphorylation genes. We demonstrated that phlda2 + cells constituted a primordial CM compartment localized between compact and trabecular muscles. Genetic ablation of phlda2 + CMs during development severely disrupted heart morphogenesis, leading to defective myocardial trabeculation and compaction, and impaired coronary vascularization. Surprisingly, despite their essential roles in development, the depletion of phlda2 + CMs didn’t impair myocardial restoration and revascularization following ventricular resection. We found that this was probably due to the limited regenerative capacity of the primordial CMs themselves, as they failed to regenerate after either surgical amputation or genetic ablation. Our findings identify primordial CMs as an organizer for heart morphogenesis but not essential for regeneration, revealing a fundamental difference between developmental and regenerative programs in the vertebrate heart.
items.title_zh: 原始心肌细胞在心脏形态发生中的作用及其再生的非必需性
items.summary_zh: 脊椎动物心脏由异质心肌细胞（CM）群体组成，但不同CM亚群在心脏发育和修复中的作用尚不明确。本研究通过对成年斑马鱼心脏进行单细胞RNA测序分析，识别出一种独特的CM亚群，标记为phlda2，主要与厌氧代谢相关，且不同于富含氧化磷酸化基因的成熟CM。我们证明phlda2+细胞构成了位于致密肌和小梁肌之间的原始CM区间。发育过程中基因去除phlda2+ CM严重干扰了心脏形态发生，导致心肌小梁和致密化缺陷以及冠状血管化受损。令人惊讶的是，尽管在发育中发挥重要作用，去除phlda2+ CM并未影响心室切除后的心肌恢复和再血管化。我们发现这可能是由于原始CM自身的有限再生能力，因为它们在外科切除或基因去除后未能再生。我们的研究表明，原始CM在心脏形态发生中起组织者作用，但对再生并非必需，揭示了脊椎动物心脏发育与再生程序之间的根本差异。

items.title: Cortical layer 6b mediates state-dependent changes in brain activity and effects of orexin on waking and sleep
items.abstract: One of the most distinctive features of the mammalian cerebral cortex is its laminar structure. Of all cortical layers, layer 6b (L6b) is by far the least studied, despite exhibiting direct sensitivity to orexin and having widespread connectivity, suggesting an important role in regulating cortical oscillations and brain state. We performed chronic electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings in mice in which a subset of L6b neurons was conditionally ‘silenced’, during undisturbed conditions, after sleep deprivation (SD), and after intracerebroventricular (ICV) administration of orexin. While the total amount of waking and sleep or the response to SD were not altered, L6b-silenced mice showed a slowing of theta frequency (6–9 Hz) during wake and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, and a marked reduction of total EEG power, especially in non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep. The infusion of orexin A increased wakefulness in both genotypes, but subsequent levels of EEG slow-wave activity during NREM sleep were lower in L6b-silenced animals in the occipital derivation. In summary, these results demonstrate a role for cortical L6b in state-dependent brain oscillations and in the response to orexinergic neurotransmission. Our findings provide new insights in functions of L6b neurons and could inform the understanding of abnormal regulation of brain states in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders.
items.title_zh: 皮层6b层介导脑活动的状态依赖性变化及食欲素的影响
