items.abstract: Cesium silicate glasses, (Cs2O)x(SiO2)1−x, are candidate hosts for optical, dielectric and nuclear-waste-immobilization applications, yet the large, polarizable Cs+ cation is poorly described by conventional potentials. We combine a firstprinciples reference with a single, composition-transferable machine-learned force field for the full range x = 0–0.30, built by pooling the ab initio data of all compositions with no empirical parametrization. First-principles calculations show wide-gap insulators whose gap narrows from 5.9 to 3.3 eV, while the static dielectric constant nearly doubles and the refractive index and optical basicity rise, in agreement with experiment. The pooled potential then scales these cells to nanometre-sized glasses, reproducing the density (within ∼2%, and 5% at x = 0.20), the intact SiO4 network, and the bridging-to-non-bridging-oxygen conversion and Qn depolymerization. Its elastic constants agree with Brillouinscattering experiments, and its pair-correlation functions and structure factors match the ab initio reference. A single structural variable, the non-bridging oxygen, governs these trends quantitatively: the moduli decay exponentially to a stiffness floor with a common non-bridging-oxygen scale and the gap narrows linearly with it, making it a quantitative descriptor linking structure to the elastic, electronic and photonic properties and a transferable basis for designing heavy-alkali silicate glasses.
items.authors: Hicham Jabraoui, Yann Vaills, Michael Nolan
items.title_zh: 非桥接氧作为重极化铯硅酸盐玻璃性质的主变量
items.summary_zh: 铯硅酸盐玻璃（(Cs2O)x(SiO2)1−x）是光学、电介质和核废物固化应用的候选材料，但传统势能对大且极化的Cs+阳离子的描述不足。我们结合第一性原理参考与单一的、可转移的机器学习力场，覆盖x = 0–0.30的全范围，利用所有成分的第一性原理数据构建，无需经验参数化。计算结果显示，这些材料为宽带隙绝缘体，带隙从5.9 eV缩小至3.3 eV，静态介电常数几乎翻倍，折射率和光学碱性上升，符合实验结果。该势能可将这些单元缩放至纳米级玻璃，重现密度（误差约2%，在x = 0.20时为5%）、完整的SiO4网络及桥接氧与非桥接氧的转化和Qn去聚合。其弹性常数与布里渊散射实验一致，配对相关函数和结构因子与第一性原理参考匹配。非桥接氧作为单一结构变量定量主导这些趋势：模量以共同的非桥接氧尺度指数衰减至刚度底线，带隙与之线性缩小，成为连接结构与弹性、电子及光子性质的定量描述符。

items.title: Unveiling the Potential of Biobased Bifuran unit in Conjugated Polymers: Synthesis, Thermal Properties, Photophysics, and Comparative Study with Phenylene and Thiophene Analogues for OLED Applications
items.abstract: The bifuran unit is an attractive biobased building block for organic electronics, however its potential in electroluminescent devices has not been explored. In this study, a series of bifuranbased conjugated polymers, PBFAr1–PBFAr9, was synthesized via Suzuki–Miyaura polycondensation to evaluate the effect of the bifuran unit on thermal, photophysical, and electrochemical properties. For comparison, analogous polymers containing phenylene (PSPhAr1), biphenyl (PBPhAr1), and bithiophene (PBTAr1) units were also synthesized. Characterization showed that the bifuran-containing polymers exhibit varied thermal stability, emission in both solution and the solid state. Specifically, the photoluminescence quantum yield of chloroform solution of PBFAr1 was 43%, which was higher than the 39% observed for the bithiophene-based analogue, PBTAr1. Kelvin probe measurements indicated an energy-level alignment with the ITO anode that may facilitate hole injection. Solution-processed OLEDs with an ITO/PEDOT:PSS/emissive polymer/LiF/Al architecture were fabricated, and the PBFAr1-based device exhibited bright cyan electroluminescence at 484 nm. These results suggest that bifuranbased conjugated polymers have potential as emissive and p-type semiconducting materials for organic optoelectronic applications.
items.authors: Shekhar Gupta, Yuya Tanaka, Nobuya Hiroshiba, Takeshi Mori, Hitoshi Saomoto, Ryusei Makiko
items.title_zh: 揭示生物基双呋喃单元在共轭聚合物中的潜力
items.summary_zh: 双呋喃单元是一种具有吸引力的生物基构建块，但其在电致发光器件中的潜力尚未被探索。本研究合成了一系列基于双呋喃的共轭聚合物PBFAr1–PBFAr9，通过铃木-宫浦聚合评估双呋喃单元对热学、光物理和电化学性质的影响。为比较，还合成了含有苯基（PSPhAr1）、联苯（PBPhAr1）和双噻吩（PBTAr1）单元的类似聚合物。表征结果显示，含双呋喃的聚合物展现出不同的热稳定性，在溶液和固态下均有发光。特别是PBFAr1在氯仿溶液中的光致发光量子产率为43%，高于双噻吩基类似物PBTAr1的39%。开尔文探针测量表明其能级与ITO阳极的对齐可能有助于孔注入。采用ITO/PEDOT:PSS/发光聚合物/LiF/Al结构制造的溶液处理OLED中，基于PBFAr1的器件在484 nm处展现出明亮的青色电致发光。这些结果表明，基于双呋喃的共轭聚合物在有机光电应用中具有作为发光和p型半导体材料的潜力。

items.title: A Distributed Diffusion Landscape Governs CO2 Coproduct Release from Fatty Acid Photodecarboxylase
items.abstract: The diffusion of small ligands within proteins is a fundamental yet poorly resolved step in enzymatic turnover.Recent studies have shown that ligand migration can involve networks of transient internal cavities and multiple competing exit routes, raising the question of whether such heterogeneity is a general feature of small-molecule egress.Here, we address this question in fatty acid photodecarboxylase (FAP), a light-driven enzyme that generates CO 2 as a small diffusive coproduct during fatty-acid decarboxylation.Using nine independent classical molecular dynamics simulations of Cv FAP, we show that CO 2 escapes the protein on the µs timescale with kinetics consistent with time-resolved infrared measurements, whereas the alkane product remains bound on the simulated timescale.Before release, CO 2 diffuses through a heterogeneous network of transient cavities, populating several distinct sites before escaping through multiple competing surface exit pathways rather than a single dominant route.One cavity positions CO 2 near C432, consistent with formation of the thiocarbonate intermediate previously identified.CO 2 release is likewise distributed among multiple surface exit points, none corresponding to the water channel observed in the dark-state enzyme.These findings reveal that CO 2 clearance in FAP occurs through an intrinsically heterogeneous diffusion landscape. SignificanceProtein function often depends on the ability of small molecules to move through the protein, but how these molecules find their way out of buried active sites remains poorly understood.Using molecular dynamics simulations of fatty acid photodecarboxylase, we show that CO 2 egress is not governed by a single structural pathway.Instead, CO 2 migrates through a dynamic network of transient cavities and escapes through multiple competing surface routes.The resulting release kinetics are consistent with experimental measurements, linking the heterogeneous diffusion landscape to the observed timescale of CO 2 release.Our findings highlight how protein conformational dynamics can create distributed and multiroute pathways for small-molecule transport, providing an atomistic framework for understanding product egress from enzymes.
items.authors: Gianluca Dell'Orletta, Isabella Daidone
items.title_zh: 分布式扩散景观控制脂肪酸光脱羧酶的CO2副产物释放
items.summary_zh: 小配体在蛋白质内的扩散是酶促反应中的一个基本但尚未充分解析的步骤。本研究聚焦于脂肪酸光脱羧酶（FAP），该酶在脂肪酸脱羧反应中生成CO2作为小的扩散副产物。通过九次独立的经典分子动力学模拟，我们发现CO2在微秒时间尺度上从蛋白质中逃逸，其动力学与时间分辨红外测量结果一致，而烷烃产物在模拟时间尺度内保持结合状态。CO2在释放前通过一个异质的瞬态腔体网络扩散，经过多个不同的位点，最终通过多个竞争的表面出口路径逃逸，而非单一主导路径。研究表明，FAP中的CO2清除通过一种内在的异质扩散景观进行。

items.title: Is Bioorthogonal Pretargeting Superior to Conventional Targeted Photosensitizers? A Comparative Study of Chlorin Delivery Using Biotin Vectors
items.abstract: Bioorthogonal pretargeting offers a modular approach to targeted photodynamic therapy (PDT), but its advantages over conventional ligand-photosensitizer conjugates remain insufficiently explored. Here, we aimed to directly compare preformed biotin-containing conjugates with sequential biotin-mediated bioorthogonal delivery. DFT calculations were used to guide the design of new tetrazine dienes with tuned electronic properties for inverse-electron-demand Diels-Alder (IEDDA) chemistry. The selected tetrazines were synthesized and paired with BCN- and s-TCO-functionalized chlorin photosensitizers, and their reactivity was characterized by second-order rate constants and photophysical measurements. In vitro, sequential pretargeting produced substantially higher intracellular fluorescence than administration of preformed 1:1 ligation products; however, this advantage did not translate into enhanced photodynamic activity. Moreover, neither accumulation nor PDT efficacy consistently correlated with SLC5A6 expression in SMVT-high SK-BR-3 versus SMVT-low MDA-MB-231 cells. Free-biotin competition produced heterogeneous, combination-dependent effects, indicating that SMVT is unlikely to be the sole determinant of uptake.
items.authors: Petar Jankovic, Anastasia A. Gorokhova, Ilya A. Shmyrov, Jana M. Svetlova, Natalia S. Kuzmina, Alexander V. Nyuchev
items.title_zh: 生物正交预靶向是否优于传统靶向光敏剂？氯素递送的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 生物正交预靶向为靶向光动力疗法（PDT）提供了一种模块化的方法，但其相对于传统配体-光敏剂结合物的优势尚未充分探讨。本研究直接比较了预制的生物素含量结合物与顺序生物素介导的生物正交递送。通过密度泛函理论（DFT）计算指导设计具有调谐电子性质的新型四氮唑二烯，以用于逆电子需求Diels-Alder（IEDDA）反应。合成的四氮唑与BCN和s-TCO功能化的氯素光敏剂配对，其反应性通过二级速率常数和光物理测量进行表征。在体外实验中，顺序预靶向产生的细胞内荧光显著高于预制1:1结合产物的给药；然而，这一优势并未转化为增强的光动力活性。此外，SLC5A6表达与SMVT高的SK-BR-3细胞与SMVT低的MDA-MB-231细胞的积累或PDT效能之间并未一致相关。自由生物素竞争产生了异质的、依赖组合的效应，表明SMVT不太可能是摄取的唯一决定因素。

items.title: A Metallic Ground State in a Niobium-Pyrazine Coordination Framework
items.abstract: Conductive metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) based on low-valent heavy transition metals remain largely unexplored despite the strong metal-ligand covalency and extended orbitals that should favor electronic delocalization. Herein, we report Nb(pyz) 2 Cl 2 (pyz = pyrazine), a layered coordination framework with a metallic electronic ground state. Although charge transport in pressed pellets is limited by thermally activated grain-boundary hopping, the high room-temperature conductivity of 1.2 S cm⁻ 1 , temperature-independent Pauli susceptibility, finite Sommerfeld coefficient (g = 14.0(5) mJ K⁻ 2 mol⁻ 1 ), Wilson ratio close to unity, and periodic density functional theory calculations consistently demonstrate a finite density of states at the Fermi level. X-ray absorption spectroscopy further reveals a strongly delocalized electronic structure involving mixed Nb 4d, Cl 3p, and pyz p* states. These results identify low-valent early-4d ions as promising components for electronically delocalized coordination solids and extend metallic metal-organic frameworks beyond the 3d transition-metal series.
items.authors: Michał Magott, Dominik Dzierżek, Katia Dujarric, Pierre Dechambenoit, Mathieu Rouzières, Gabriela Handzlik
items.title_zh: 铌-吡嗪配位框架中的金属基态研究
items.summary_zh: 基于低价重过渡金属的导电金属有机框架（MOFs）尚未得到充分探索，尽管金属-配体的强共价性和扩展轨道有利于电子的离域化。本文报道了Nb(pyz)₂Cl₂（pyz = 吡嗪），一种具有金属电子基态的层状配位框架。尽管在压制颗粒中的电荷传输受到热激活的晶界跃迁限制，但其室温导电率高达1.2 S cm⁻¹，温度无关的保利磁化率，有限的索默费尔德系数（g = 14.0(5) mJ K⁻² mol⁻¹），接近于1的威尔逊比，以及周期性密度泛函理论计算一致表明费米能级处存在有限的态密度。X射线吸收光谱进一步揭示了涉及混合Nb 4d、Cl 3p和pyz p*态的强离域化电子结构。这些结果表明低价早期4d离子是电子离域化配位固体的有前景的组成部分，并将金属有机框架的研究扩展至3d过渡金属系列之外。

items.title: Deployability-First Benchmarking of LFIA Innovation: A Framework and COVID-19 Literature Audit
items.abstract: Lateral flow immunoassays (LFIAs) are operationally simple, enabling low-barrier, decentralized testing. Their reported performance should therefore be interpreted in relation to the deployability of the required workflow. LFIA innovations often seek improved detection performance, commonly expressed as lower limits of detection (LODs), but workflows can differ substantially in burden and testing conditions. To guide experimental planning, interpretation of results, and formulation of performance claims, we developed a deployability-first benchmarking framework. At the planning stage, the intended deployment setting guides selection of a compatible workflow, while the performance question guides the type of evidence needed to address it. The framework distinguishes low-burden, enhanced lowburden, and higher-burden workflows. Once results are available, the implemented workflow, sample context, measured endpoint, LOD definition, and any comparator help determine what conclusions and comparisons are supported and how the claim should be framed. We applied these principles retrospectively to 96 COVID-19 LFIA innovation articles. Nearly two-thirds of workflows supporting the selected primary performance claims were higher-burden, requiring instrumentation, trained users, or laboratory conditions. Direct like-with-like benchmarking was often limited by differences in workflow burden, sample context, endpoint, LOD definition, readout mode, and comparator conditions. We operationalized result interpretation and claim framing as a claim-level checklist. Applied retrospectively to the same 96 selected primary claims, about 40% were supported as written, whereas about 60% required narrowing or reframing. COVID-19 served as a literature test case; the framework and checklist contain no COVID-19-specific criteria and were designed for medical and non-medical LFIA settings.
items.authors: Sergey N. Krylov, Xingzhi Che, Jeffrey Azzi, Svetlana M. Krylova, Nima Tabatabaei, Laura Anfossi
items.title_zh: 以可部署性为首的LFIA创新基准框架及COVID-19文献审计
items.summary_zh: 侧流免疫测定（LFIA）操作简单，便于低门槛的分散式检测。LFIA的性能应与所需工作流程的可部署性相关联。LFIA创新通常追求更好的检测性能，常以更低的检测限（LOD）表示，但工作流程在负担和检测条件上可能存在显著差异。为指导实验规划、结果解读和性能声明的制定，我们开发了以可部署性为首的基准框架。在规划阶段，预期的部署环境指导兼容工作流程的选择，而性能问题则指导所需证据的类型。该框架区分低负担、增强低负担和高负担工作流程。结果可用后，实施的工作流程、样本背景、测量终点、LOD定义及任何比较因素有助于确定支持的结论和比较方式。我们将这些原则回顾性地应用于96篇COVID-19 LFIA创新文章，发现近三分之二的工作流程为高负担，需使用仪器、训练有素的用户或实验室条件。直接的同类基准比较常因工作流程负担差异而受限。

items.title: The Role of In Situ Crosslinked Polysiloxane/Polylactide Micro-Networks on the PLA Brittle-Ductile Transition
items.abstract: Polylactide (PLA) has garnered significant attention as a potentially sustainable substitute for conventional petrochemical polymers. This attention is attributed to several factors, including its renewable origin, biodegradability, and its compatibility with conventional polymer processing techniques. However, its inherent fragility restricts its broader utilization as an engineering plastic. In this study, the investigation focused on the thermally activated reactive modification of PLA with two functional polysiloxanes of varying molecular architectures. This modification was explored as a toughening strategy, with the objective of promoting the brittle-to-ductile (BD) transition through the formation of a locally entangled polysiloxane/PLA micro-network within the PLA matrix. Extraction, thermal, spectroscopic, and morphological analyses were conducted to confirm the formation of a crosslinked phase. The micromechanical deformation mechanisms of pristine and toughened PLA under tension, bending, and impact forces are discussed, revealing that the dispersion level, size of dispersed phase, molecular weight, and reactivity of the introduced soft phase strongly influence rheological and mechanical performance, leading to markedly improved mechanical performance. For instance, impact strength reaches ∼37 kJ/m2 at 1 wt% MOD1 and elongation at break increases to 90% at 5 wt% MOD2.
items.authors: Julia Głowacka, Roksana Konieczna, Daria Pakuła, Miłosz Frydrych, Bogna Sztorch, Kosma Szutkowski
items.title_zh: 原位交联聚硅氧烷/聚乳酸微网络对PLA脆韧转变的影响
items.summary_zh: 聚乳酸（PLA）因其可再生来源、生物降解性及与传统聚合物加工技术的兼容性而受到广泛关注。然而，其固有的脆性限制了其作为工程塑料的广泛应用。本研究探讨了通过两种不同分子结构的功能性聚硅氧烷对PLA进行热激活反应性改性，以促进PLA中的脆韧转变。通过提取、热分析、光谱分析和形态分析确认了交联相的形成。讨论了原始PLA和改性PLA在拉伸、弯曲和冲击力下的微观力学变形机制，结果表明，分散程度、分散相大小、分子量及引入软相的反应性对流变和力学性能有显著影响，机械性能显著提高。例如，在1 wt% MOD1时，冲击强度达到约37 kJ/m²，而在5 wt% MOD2时，断裂伸长率增加至90%。

items.title: Morphology-Dependent Excited-State Dynamics in Hollow Sphere Poly(Heptazine Imide) Photocatalysts
items.abstract: Photocatalytic oxygen reduction to hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) over stable, earthabundant materials is attractive for solar energy conversion. The question how photocatalyst morphology governs photocatalytic performance remains, however, poorly understood, as the contributions of surface area and charge-carrier dynamics are convoluted. Herein, we investigate a series of hard-templated hollow potassium poly(heptazine imide) (PHI) spheres (KPHIS) with varying shell thickness and porosity. The photocatalytic H2O2 production is benchmarked against bulk KPHI and correlated with excited-state dynamics probed by steadystate and time-resolved photoluminescence and femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy under quencher-free and donor-containing conditions. Notably, whilst all KPHIS outperform bulk KPHI, the activity varies non-monotonically with shell thickness and excitation wavelength, whereby the thickest-shelled sphere ‒ not the one with the highest specific surface area and pore volume ‒ is most active at 365 and 406 nm, with apparent quantum yields up to ~3.9%. These experiments reveal that the activity is governed not by porosity alone but by the kinetic competition between donor-mediated hole extraction (least efficient in the most porous sample at low wavelength irradiation) and stabilization of long-lived reduced states that drive O2 reduction. Shell thickness should be co-optimized with light penetration depth and donorconditioned charge dynamics, rather than maximizing porosity alone.
items.authors: Alexander Lange, Lingli Ni, Arindam Konar, Andreas Stihl, Dariusz Mitoraj, Marius Hermesdorf
items.title_zh: 空心球聚（七嗪酰亚胺）光催化剂的形态依赖激发态动力学
items.summary_zh: 稳定且丰富的材料在光催化氧还原生成过氧化氢（H2O2）方面具有吸引力，但光催化剂形态如何影响其性能仍不清楚。本研究探讨了一系列硬模板空心钾聚（七嗪酰亚胺）（KPHIS）球体，具有不同的壳厚和孔隙度。通过稳态和时间分辨光致发光及飞秒瞬态吸收光谱，在无淬灭剂和含供体条件下，评估了光催化H2O2的生成与体相KPHI的对比。结果显示，所有KPHIS的性能均优于体相KPHI，但活性与壳厚和激发波长呈非单调关系，最厚壳球体在365和406 nm下表现出最高活性，量子产率可达约3.9%。研究表明，活性不仅受孔隙度影响，还受到供体介导的孔提取与长寿命还原态稳定化之间的动力学竞争的影响。

items.title: Interface-Engineered MXene/TMD Heterostructures for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution: Progress, DFT-Guided Mechanisms, and Perspectives
items.abstract: The hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) requires efficient, durable, and earth-abundant electrocatalysts to reduce reliance on platinum-group metals. MXene/transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures offer a promising platform by combining the abundant, tunable catalytic sites of TMDs with the high electrical conductivity, hydrophilicity, and versatile surface chemistry of MXenes. This review critically examines recent advances in the synthesis, interfacial engineering, and HER performance of MXene/TMD heterostructures, with particular emphasis on how interfacial interactions govern catalytic behavior. The roles of phase engineering, defect and heteroatom incorporation, surface terminations, and heterointerface construction are discussed in relation to interfacial charge redistribution, electronic-structure modulation, hydrogen adsorption energetics, active-site accessibility, and reaction kinetics. Experimental HER performance across representative MXene/TMD systems is compared to establish structure-interface-performance relationships and identify the origins of enhanced activity and stability. Particular attention is given to density functional theory (DFT) as a mechanistic tool for resolving heterostructure stability, interfacial charge transfer, electronic structure, and hydrogen adsorption free energy (ΔGH*). The review also assesses limitations in current computational descriptions of electrocatalytic interfaces, including solvent and electrolyte effects, potential-dependent surface charging, dynamic surface reconstruction, and the accuracy of commonly used exchange-correlation functionals. By integrating experimental observations with theoretical insights, this review identifies interfacial electronic coupling and local active-site chemistry as central determinants of HER performance, while highlighting oxidation stability, interfacial reproducibility, realistic electrochemical modeling, and scalable fabrication as persistent challenges. Finally, future directions combining controlled interfacial synthesis, operando characterization, and advanced constant-potential and solvent-inclusive simulations are proposed to accelerate the development of efficient and durable MXene/TMD electrocatalysts for green hydrogen production.
items.authors: Sana Akir, Sajjad Ali, Levna Chacko, Amutha Subramani, Qaisar Alam, Zdeněk Sofer
items.title_zh: 界面工程化MXene/TMD异质结构用于高效氢气演化反应
items.summary_zh: 氢气演化反应（HER）需要高效、耐用且丰富的电催化剂，以减少对铂族金属的依赖。MXene/过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）异质结构通过结合TMD的丰富可调催化位点与MXene的高电导率、亲水性和多样化表面化学，提供了一个有前景的平台。本文回顾了MXene/TMD异质结构在合成、界面工程和HER性能方面的最新进展，特别强调了界面相互作用如何影响催化行为。讨论了相工程、缺陷和异原子掺入、表面终止及异质界面构建在界面电荷重分布、电子结构调制、氢吸附能量、活性位点可及性和反应动力学中的作用。通过比较代表性MXene/TMD系统的实验HER性能，建立了结构-界面-性能关系，并识别出增强活性和稳定性的来源。特别关注密度泛函理论（DFT）作为解析异质结构稳定性、界面电荷转移、电子结构和氢吸附自由能（ΔGH*）的机制工具。

items.title: Machine Learning Optimization of Polymeric Complex Coacervate Micelles Reveals Cell-Type-Specific Formulations for Enhanced mRNA Delivery
items.abstract: The cell-type dependent transfection heterogeneity of polymeric mRNA delivery remains a fundamental barrier to their broad translation. The field has historically addressed this by optimizing the cationic component itself, refining amine identity, density, and block architecture to maximize transfection. Even highly optimized cationic carriers, however, still transfect some cell types well and others poorly, because no single cation chemistry can simultaneously match the internalization and cytoplasmic trafficking biology of every target. Rather than seeking a universally optimal carrier chemistry, we instead sought a tunable formulation framework capable of adapting charge balance and interfacial properties across distinct cellular environments. Here, we report a multicomponent complex coacervate micelle platform in which a cationic oligoamine-functionalized A7 amphiphile , an anionic poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (CEA) homopolymer, and a neutral-anionic poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (PEG-CEA) diblock are co-assembled into a single carrier, with the anionic and stealth components associating electrostatically with the cationic micelle as external corona species. Closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization (qNEHVI) of the A7/CEA/PEG-CEA formulation simplex over three rounds in HEK293T cells identified a productive ternary region that increased effective efficiency (delivery × viability) from ~0.35 for the A7 homomicelle to approximately 0.8 for the best mixed micelle. The resulting 35-formulation library was directly screened across six additional cell types (A549, MDA-MB-231, HuH7, OVCAR8, HEK001, and primary patient-derived fibroblasts), where the best mixed micelle outperformed all polymer-based commercial reagents in every cell line. The winning composition was different in every cell line, establishing tunability rather than a single fixed optimum as the platform's central practical advantage. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) attribution on Random Forest surrogates then converted these cell-line-specific winners into transferable design rules, identifying which formulation descriptors drive delivery and viability in each cellular context. Together, this work delivers a tunable polymeric transfection platform and a framework for cell-type-aware design of mRNA carriers.
items.authors: Sidharth Panda, Theresa M. Reineke
items.title_zh: 聚合物复合共沉淀胶束的机器学习优化提升mRNA递送效率
items.summary_zh: 聚合物mRNA递送的细胞类型依赖性转染异质性是其广泛应用的基本障碍。传统上，研究通过优化阳离子成分来解决这一问题，但即使是高度优化的阳离子载体在不同细胞类型中的转染效果仍然差异显著。我们提出了一种可调配方框架，能够在不同细胞环境中适应电荷平衡和界面特性。本文报告了一种多组分复合共沉淀胶束平台，其中阳离子寡胺功能化的A7表面活性剂、阴离子聚（羧乙基丙烯酸酯）(CEA)均聚物和中性-阴离子聚（乙烯醇）-b-聚（羧乙基丙烯酸酯）(PEG-CEA)二嵌段共聚物共同组装成单一载体。通过对A7/CEA/PEG-CEA配方的闭环多目标贝叶斯优化，识别出在HEK293T细胞中有效的三元区域，显著提高了转染效率。

items.title: Melt-State Ligand Addition Generates a Near-Infrared-Emissive Coordination Polymer Glass
items.abstract: Meltable coordination polymers (CPs) combine liquid-phase processability with the structural and functional diversity of crystalline coordination compounds, but methods to install targeted local coordination environments and photophysical functions in CP glasses remain limited. Here, we demonstrate that 1,10-phenanthroline (phen) reacts with the 1D-extended Cu I -CP Cu(ipim) (Cuip; ipim − = 2-isopropylimidazolate) in the melt, converting half of the linearly coordinated Cu I sites into pseudo-tetrahedral [Cu(phen)(ipim) 2 ] − units while preserving chain topology and the interchain-separation melting mechanism. Depending on thermal history, the resulting phen 0.5 Cuip forms either a melt-quenched glass or crystalline polymorphs, whereas pristine Cuip invariably recrystallizes on cooling. X-ray total scattering and spectroscopic analyses show that the local Cu I -phen motif is retained across the phases, while the coordination geometry, interchain order, and phen···phen π-stacking interactions differ. Ligand addition transforms the photophysics from green phosphorescence in Cuip to broad near-infrared emission centered at approximately 850 nm in both crystalline and glassy phen 0.5 Cuip. The pronounced temperature dependence of this emission is consistent with a thermally activated delayed fluorescence mechanism. Calculations indicate that the extended CP environment restricts flattening of the pseudo-tetrahedral [Cu(phen)(ipim) 2 ] − units after metal-to-ligand charge-transfer (MLCT) excitation, thereby limiting access to non-radiative decay pathways. Melt-state ligand addition thus provides a route to construct molecular-complex-like functional units during processing, linking reactive CP melt chemistry to targeted photophysical design in CP glasses.
items.authors: Jan-Benedikt Weiß, Michael Nuss, Taichi Nishiguchi, Zichong Yu, Giulia Rosano, Ellan K. Berdichevsky
items.title_zh: 熔融态配体添加生成近红外发射配位聚合物玻璃
items.summary_zh: 可熔融配位聚合物（CPs）结合了液相加工性与晶体配位化合物的结构和功能多样性，但在CP玻璃中安装特定局部配位环境和光物理功能的方法仍然有限。本研究展示了1,10-菲啰啉（phen）在熔融态下与一维扩展的Cu I -CP Cu(ipim)（Cuip；ipim− = 2-异丙基咪唑酸盐）反应，将一半线性配位的Cu I 位点转化为伪四面体[Cu(phen)(ipim)2]−单元，同时保持链拓扑和链间分离熔化机制。根据热历史，生成的phen0.5Cuip形成熔融淬火玻璃或晶态多晶型，而原始Cuip在冷却时则不可避免地再结晶。X射线全散射和光谱分析表明，局部Cu I -phen结构在各相中保持不变，但配位几何、链间有序性及phen···phen π-堆叠相互作用有所不同。配体添加使得光物理特性从Cuip中的绿色磷光转变为在晶态和玻璃态phen0.5Cuip中约850 nm的宽近红外发射。该发射的明显温度依赖性与热激活延迟荧光机制一致。计算表明，扩展的CP环境限制了f。

items.title: Effects due to the solvent density distribution on the dynamics of polymer coils in solution under rheological flow fields
items.abstract: We study the behaviour of highly resolved polymer chains under rheological flow fields encompassing varying levels of hydrodynamic interactions (HI) using dissipative particle dynamics (DPD) simulations. The chains are discretized to a single Kuhn step, while the spring lengths set the level of HI. While the overall trends agree with Brownian dynamics (BD) simulations of similarly resolved chains, the balance of drag and restoring spring forces is unable to explain the chain stretch obtained for DPD simulations with higher HI (lower spring length) at moderately large flow rates. For compact coils showing high levels of HI in DPD simulations, the solvent density remains low deep inside the coil, which persists to some extent even as the chains stretch at higher flow rates. In contrast, the solvent density remains nearly constant, at the bulk value, across expanded coils with larger spring lengths. We show how this density distribution has implications for the viscosity of the interface between the polymer coil and solvent and provides a correction to the viscosity used in the drag force expression, which explains the chain stretch values observed in simulations. CFD simulations show the decay of the influence of one sphere on another beyond a separation of one diameter and the persistence of the same for a linear array of spheres, which allows the assumption of a thin cylinder for the drag force.
items.authors: Sanjay Jana, Rishi Kumar, S V Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal
items.title_zh: 溶剂密度分布对聚合物链在流场中动力学的影响
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了在流变流场下高分辨率聚合物链的行为，采用耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟，涵盖不同水平的流体动力学相互作用（HI）。链条被离散化为单个库恩步长，弹簧长度设定了HI的水平。尽管整体趋势与布朗动力学（BD）模拟结果一致，但在中等流速下，拖曳力与恢复弹簧力的平衡无法解释DPD模拟中高HI（较短弹簧长度）下的链伸展。对于在DPD模拟中显示出高HI的紧凑卷曲，溶剂密度在卷曲内部保持较低，即使在较高流速下链条伸展时仍然如此。相比之下，扩展卷曲的溶剂密度几乎保持恒定。我们展示了这种密度分布对聚合物卷曲与溶剂界面的粘度的影响，并为拖曳力表达式中的粘度提供了修正，解释了模拟中观察到的链伸展值。CFD模拟显示，球体之间的影响在分离超过一个直径后衰减，而在球体的线性阵列中这种影响持续存在。

items.title: Unlocking Ligand-Centered Redox Activity in an Indenyl Framework through Phosphorus Substitution
items.abstract: Herein, we show that a phosphonium-substituted diphosphaindenylide (PPIPh) functions as a genuine two-electron redox-active π-ligand. The cationic manganese complex [Mn(CO)3(η5‑PPIPh)][BArF24] ([1][BArF24]) undergoes a reversible two-electron reduction to afford the isolable anionic complex [K(18c6)][Mn(CO)3(η3‑PPIPh)]·([K(18c6)][BArF24])n (n = 1 – 5). This constitutes the first isolable and structurally characterized two-electron redox couple of an indenyl-derived manganese complex, which has previously eluded isolation with purely carbocyclic indenyl ligands. Computational studies establish manganese in the +I oxidation state in both complexes, demonstrating that the redox process is exclusively ligand-centered. The redox-activity of the ligand also translates into chemical reactivity, with the anionic complex affording 91% yield in the hydroboration of 2-acetonaphthone, compared to only 7% for [1][BArF24].
items.authors: David Zuber, Michael Neuwirt, Peter Coburger
items.title_zh: 通过磷取代解锁印烯框架中的配体中心氧化还原活性
items.summary_zh: 本研究表明，磷鎓取代的二磷烯印烯配体（PPIPh）作为一种真正的双电子氧化还原活性π-配体。阳离子锰复合物[Mn(CO)3(η5‑PPIPh)][BArF24] ([1][BArF24])经历可逆的双电子还原，生成可分离的阴离子复合物[K(18c6)][Mn(CO)3(η3‑PPIPh)]·([K(18c6)][BArF24])n（n = 1 – 5）。这是首个可分离且结构表征的印烯衍生锰复合物的双电子氧化还原对，以前仅用纯碳环印烯配体未能实现。计算研究表明，两个复合物中的锰均为+I氧化态，证明了氧化还原过程完全是配体中心的。配体的氧化还原活性也转化为化学反应性，阴离子复合物在2-乙酰萘酮的氢硼化反应中获得91%的产率，而[1][BArF24]仅为7%。

items.title: Advanced HILIC-MS Analysis of Therapeutic siRNAs with Non-Canonical Backbones and Conjugate Scaffolds
items.abstract: The evolution of small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutics toward increasingly complex chemical architecture has created analytical challenges for structural characterization. Confident sequencing and site-specific localization of modifications by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) remain difficult due to non-canonical backbone chemistry, diverse chemical modifications and attached conjugates, all contributing to heterogeneous fragmentation. We present an ion-pair-free hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (HILIC–MS/MS) workflow that enables non-denaturing and denaturing analysis of conjugated, heavily modified siRNA constructs through temperature-controlled separation. Under non-denaturing conditions, duplexes can be evaluated to assess therapeutic integrity and stability, whereas elevated temperatures achieve duplex dissociation, permitting chromatographic separation and MS/MS analysis of sense and antisense strands. The method was benchmarked using multiple siRNA therapeutics of increasing structural complexity, including the unconjugated duplex ATU027, patisiran, a Huntingtin (HTT)-targeting siRNA containing an extended nucleic acid (exNA) backbone, and a GalNAc-conjugated siRNA drug, fitusiran. Complementary activation methods, including collision-induced dissociation (CID), higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD), and ultraviolet photodissociation (UVPD), produced extensive backbone fragmentation and high sequence coverage while also revealing conjugate-specific fragmentation pathways for GalNAc siRNA. Customized Nucleo-SAFARI software supported confident localization of chemical modifications, non-canonical backbone chemistries, and conjugation sites. These results establish temperature-controlled HILIC–MS/MS as a versatile analytical framework for robust structural characterization of complex therapeutic siRNAs.
items.authors: Mohamed I. Gadallah, Noha M El Zahar, Thanh Nguyen, Michael B. Lanzillotti, Kailyn L. Nonhof, Nicholas McHugh
items.title_zh: 非典型骨架和结合支架的治疗性siRNA的HILIC-MS分析
items.summary_zh: 小干扰RNA（siRNA）治疗的化学结构日益复杂，给结构表征带来了分析挑战。由于非典型骨架化学、多样的化学修饰和附加结合物，串联质谱（MS/MS）在序列确认和特定位点修饰定位方面仍然困难。我们提出了一种无离子对的亲水相互作用液相色谱-质谱（HILIC-MS/MS）工作流程，能够通过温控分离对结合的、重修饰的siRNA构建体进行非变性和变性分析。在非变性条件下，可以评估双链的治疗完整性和稳定性，而在高温下实现双链解离，允许对正义链和反义链进行色谱分离和MS/MS分析。该方法通过多种结构复杂性逐渐增加的siRNA治疗药物进行基准测试，包括未结合的双链ATU027、patisiran、靶向亨廷顿蛋白（HTT）的扩展核酸（exNA）骨架siRNA以及GalNAc结合的siRNA药物fitusiran。

items.title: Impact of SEI Formation History on Lithium Metal Electrode Stability at Elevated Temperatures
items.abstract: Solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) is critical for stabilizing lithium metal anodes, yet its evolution under thermal stress and the role of its formation history remain poorly understood. Here, lithium plating and stripping on Cu electrodes were investigated in 1.0 and 5.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI)/propylene carbonate electrolytes at 25 and 80 °C using electrochemical measurements, Raman spectroscopy, hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES), and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS). Raman spectra showed that the bulk solvation structure changed little with temperature, whereas HAXPES and XAS revealed that elevated temperature accelerated LiFSI decomposition, inorganic enrichment, and SEI growth, leading to increased interfacial resistance and unstable cycling. Electronic-structure calculations showed that increasing LiFSI concentration enhanced the FSI− contribution to the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO), while elevated temperature lowered FSI−-derived unoccupied states, favoring anion reduction. Pre-cycling at room temperature markedly improved subsequent operation at 80 °C, particularly with the concentrated electrolyte. These results demonstrate that high-temperature stability is governed by the combined effects of electrolyte concentration, temperature, and SEI formation history, providing a mechanistic basis for controlling SEI formation and stabilizing lithium plating and stripping under thermal stress.
items.authors: Yutaro Goto, Yuki Miyaura, Takeru Hamada, Yuta Shiomi, Keiji Shimoda, Chengchao Zhong
items.title_zh: SEI形成历史对锂金属电极高温稳定性的影响
items.summary_zh: 固态电解质界面（SEI）对锂金属阳极的稳定性至关重要，但其在热应力下的演变及形成历史的作用尚不明确。本研究通过电化学测量、拉曼光谱、硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）和X射线吸收光谱（XAS），在25°C和80°C下研究了1.0和5.0 M氟磺酰亚胺锂（LiFSI）/丙烯碳酸酯电解质中锂在铜电极上的沉积与剥离。结果表明，拉曼光谱显示体相溶剂结构随温度变化不大，而HAXPES和XAS揭示高温加速了LiFSI分解、无机物富集和SEI生长，导致界面电阻增加和循环不稳定。电子结构计算显示，增加LiFSI浓度增强了FSI−对最低未占分子轨道（LUMO）的贡献，而高温降低了FSI−衍生的未占态，促进了阴离子还原。室温预循环显著改善了后续在80°C下的操作，尤其是在浓缩电解质中。这些结果表明，高温稳定性受电解质浓度、温度和SEI形成历史的综合影响，为控制SEI形成提供了机制基础。

items.title: BigMixSolDB: Extraction of a solubility database in solvent mixtures with an uncertainty-quantified large language model-based pipeline
items.abstract: The rapidly expanding body of chemical literature contains physical data scattered across unstructured text and complex tables in thousands of publications. Translating this information into machine-readable formats is essential for training data-driven chemical models. The lack of uncertainty quantification in computationally extracted datasets makes manual extraction and curation still necessary. We here address this challenge and present an uncertainty-quantified data extraction pipeline. Our fully automated pipeline utilizes large language models (LLMs) to extract complex tabular and textual chemical data directly from scientific PDFs. We systematically assess several modern LLMs and document-to-text conversion frameworks. We benchmark the uncertainty in extracted data by comparison of our computationally extracted databases with large, existing databases on solubility that are manually curated. Our pipeline achieves between 93 and 79% of the literature contained data, with near-zero median log deviations for structurally matched rows and residual high-magnitude errors concentrated in a small subset of OCR, table-structure, unit-scaling, or reference-dataset discrepancies. We showcase the utility of our pipeline by deploying it to extract data from over 2,000 articles and generate BigMixSolDB, a comprehensive database on solubility in complex mixtures. BigMixSolDB comprises 280,273 solubility entries spanning single, binary, and ternary solvent systems. Our results demonstrate how integrated LLM-based pipelines can be used for literature data extraction that is comparable with manual curation. We envision that these frameworks can be used for large-scale, accurate extraction of literature data into datasets for machine learning applications
items.authors: Andrei Voinea, Anna C.M. Thöni, Elija Veenman, Wilhelm T.S. Huck, Tal Kachman, Mathijs F.J. Mabesoone
items.title_zh: BigMixSolDB：基于不确定性量化的大语言模型溶解度数据库提取
items.summary_zh: 化学文献中物理数据分散在大量非结构化文本和复杂表格中，转化为机器可读格式对数据驱动的化学模型训练至关重要。我们提出了一种不确定性量化的数据提取管道，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从科学PDF中自动提取复杂的化学数据。通过与手动整理的大型溶解度数据库对比，我们评估了提取数据的不确定性。我们的管道在提取的数据中实现了93%至79%的文献覆盖率，结构匹配行的中位数对数偏差接近零，残余高幅度误差主要集中在少量OCR、表格结构、单位缩放或参考数据集差异上。我们从2000多篇文章中提取数据，生成了BigMixSolDB，这是一个关于复杂混合物中溶解度的综合数据库。

items.title: Explainable ML force-field for evaluating protein–ligand binding energy using SO3LR
items.abstract: Accurate estimation of protein–ligand binding affinities remains central to structure-based drug design. Classical force fields neglect important quantum-mechanical effects, while quantum mechanical and semi-empirical methods remain impractical for large biomolecular systems. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) offer an alternative, but their performance may be inflated by training on protein–ligand complexes. Here, we introduce SO3LR-SF, a physics-based scoring function built on the pretrained SO3LR MLFF, combining an equivariant message-passing network for semi-local interactions with physically motivated terms for short-range repulsion, electrostatics, and long-range dispersion. Built on an MLFF that was not trained on protein–ligand complexes, SO3LR-SF provides a stringent test of transferability. On PLA15 (15 active-site models), SO3LR-SF attains a relative interaction error of 5.8% against DLPNO-CCSD(T) references, the lowest of all tested methods. On the FEP benchmark (8 targets, 264 ligands), SO3LR-SF achieves an average Spearman correlation of 0.51, on par with the best semi-empirical quantum-mechanical method tested (0.47, GFN-FF) and with MMGBSA (0.44), and surpassing Glide (0.27). On the Wang dataset (8 targets, 199 ligands), it reaches 0.51, approaching the 0.60 average of molecular dynamics-based free-energy methods at a fraction of their cost. Each complex is scored in 1–10 seconds on 12 CPU cores, an 80- to 300-fold speedup over comparable MLFFs. An 8 Å trimming protocol reduces runtime threefold without loss of accuracy, and a restrained geometry optimization recovers ranking accuracy for targets with strained input structures. A multi-level explainability framework adds energy decomposition, per-atom energy contributions reported either for ligand or as 2D protein–ligand interaction maps, and 3D binding site visualization. We identified two pocket descriptors that flag applicability before scoring, e.g. polar solvent accessible surface area (SASA) ratio correlating strongly (r = 0.81) with performance. Together, SO3LR-SF presents a fast, interpretable, and competitive scoring function for drug discovery that requires no domain-specific training data.
items.authors: Hamza Agha, Sergio Suárez-Dou, Adil Kabylda, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Andrea Volkamer
items.title_zh: 可解释的机器学习力场用于评估蛋白质-配体结合能
items.summary_zh: 准确估计蛋白质-配体结合亲和力对基于结构的药物设计至关重要。传统力场忽略了重要的量子力学效应，而量子力学和半经验方法在大型生物分子系统中不够实用。机器学习力场（MLFF）提供了一种替代方案，但其性能可能因在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练而被高估。本文介绍了SO3LR-SF，这是一种基于物理的评分函数，建立在预训练的SO3LR MLFF之上，结合了用于半局部相互作用的等变消息传递网络和物理驱动的短程排斥、电静力学和长程色散项。在未在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练的MLFF基础上，SO3LR-SF提供了严格的可转移性测试。在PLA15（15个活性位点模型）上，SO3LR-SF相对于DLPNO-CCSD(T)参考值的相对相互作用误差为5.8%，为所有测试方法中最低。在FEP基准（8个目标，264个配体）上，SO3LR-SF的平均Spearman相关系数为0.51，接近最佳的半经验量子力学方法（0.47，GFN-FF）和MMGBSA（0.44），超越了Glide（0.27）。在Wang数据集（8个目标，199个配体）上，其相关系数达到0.51，接近基于分子动力学的自由能方法的0.60平均值，且成本大幅降低。

items.title: Reversibility of (De)lithiation of Antiperovskite Li2FeOS through a Paracrystalline, Mixed-Valent Intermediate
items.abstract: The antiperovskite Li 2 FeOS is simultaneously cation-disordered and heteroanionic, and delivers more than one lithium per formula unit — but the structural and redox pathway behind that capacity, and the origin of its fading, remain unclear. Combining galvanostatic intermittent titration, operando X-ray diffraction and ex situ 57 Fe Mössbauer spectroscopy across the electrochemically accessible compositional range, we separate three processes: a two-phase transformation at a flat equilibrium potential of 1.95 V vs. Li/Li + , a solid solution spanning 2.30–2.55 V, and an irreversible process above 2.6 V. Delithiation proceeds with severe loss of long-range order evident by extreme broadening and attenuation of diffracted intensity. Yet, if limited to the first two processes, accounting for ca. one lithium per formula unit, the pristine crystalline reflections are recovered exactly in position and profile on relithiation, excluding amorphization and particle-size reduction. We propose a description of the intermediate as a paracrystal, retaining the parent antiperovskite topology while losing periodicity through aperiodic displacive relaxation. 57 Fe Mössbauer isomer shifts evolve continuously through intermediate values rather than as coexisting Fe 2+ and Fe 3+ populations, indicating mixed-valent iron, and saturate near Fe 2.8+ placing the onset of anion redox earlier than the prevailing sequential cation-then-anion picture. Cells limited to 2.6 V retain 90 % of capacity over 150 cycles, against 70 % at 3.0 V. Reversible cycling of Li 2 FeOS therefore rests on a mixed-valent, paracrystalline intermediate, and capacity fade follows once sulfur oxidation is driven beyond it.
items.authors: Xavier Kouoi, Iulian Dugulan, Marine Reynaud, Theodosios Famprikis
items.title_zh: 反钙钛矿Li2FeOS的（去）锂化可逆性研究
items.summary_zh: 反钙钛矿Li2FeOS同時具有阳离子无序和异阴离子特性，每个化学式单元可释放超过一个锂离子。然而，其容量背后的结构和氧化还原路径，以及衰退的原因仍不清楚。通过恒电流间歇滴定、原位X射线衍射和外部57Fe谱学，我们分离出三个过程：在1.95 V（vs. Li/Li+）的平坦平衡电位下的两相转变，2.30–2.55 V范围内的固溶体，以及2.6 V以上的不可逆过程。去锂化过程中长程有序性严重丧失，表现为衍射强度的极度展宽和衰减。然而，若仅限于前两个过程，约占每个化学式单元一个锂离子，重新锂化时原始晶体反射完全恢复，排除了无定形化和颗粒尺寸减小。我们将中间体描述为一种准晶体，保持母体反钙钛矿拓扑结构，同时通过非周期性位移松弛失去周期性。57Fe同位素位移在中间值间连续演变，表明混合价态铁，并在Fe2.8+附近饱和，表明阴离子氧化还原反应的开始早于预期。

items.title: Non-Isobaric Is Not Enough: Gap-Merge Safety for Unambiguous Peptide Readout
items.abstract: Selecting a set of non-isobaric amino acids is the standard way to guarantee unambiguous readout when peptide sequences are used to carry information. We show it is insufficient. Because tandem MS reads residues as differences between consecutive fragment masses, a single missing b/y ion merges two adjacent residues into one observed gap; if that merged gap aliases a single residue mass, the decoder does not register a dropout but emits one confident, wrong residue. Non-isobaricity cannot prevent this, because the colliding quantity is a sum rather than a residue. We formalize the missing condition—gap-merge safety, |m(a) +m(b)−m(c)| τ for all a, b, c in the alphabet—as a decidable predicate with a machine-checked soundness proof in Lean 4, and characterize the collision structure of the proteinogenic alphabet exhaustively: beyond the Leu/Ile isobar and the Gln/Lys near-isobar, exactly two summed-gap collisions exist, Gly + Gly = Asn and Gly + Ala = Gln, making glycine disproportionately expensive. In simulation, alphabets satisfying gap-merge safety produce zero silent errors at every fragment dropout rate from 0 to 0.4, where alphabets chosen by non-isobaricity alone produce 1.0% to 6.9%; every failure becomes a detectable erasure rather than a silent substitution.
items.authors: Laalini Bhogadi
items.title_zh: 非等质量氨基酸不足：肽段读出中的缺口合并安全性
items.summary_zh: 在使用肽序列传递信息时，选择一组非等质量氨基酸是确保明确读出的标准方法。然而，我们证明这并不足够。由于串联质谱通过连续片段质量差异读取残基，单个缺失的b/y离子会将两个相邻残基合并为一个观察到的缺口；如果该合并缺口与单个残基质量重叠，解码器将不会记录缺失，而是发出一个自信但错误的残基。非等质量性无法防止这种情况，因为碰撞的量是总和而非单个残基。我们将缺口合并安全性形式化为可判定的谓词，并在Lean 4中提供了机器检查的有效性证明，全面描述了蛋白质字母表的碰撞结构：除了Leu/Ile等质量和Gln/Lys近等质量外，存在两个总和缺口碰撞，Gly + Gly = Asn和Gly + Ala = Gln，使甘氨酸的成本不成比例地高。在模拟中，满足缺口合并安全性的字母表在0到0.4的每个片段缺失率下产生零静默错误，而仅通过非等质量性选择的字母表则产生1.0%到6.9%的错误；每个失败都变成可检测的缺失，而非静默替代。

items.title: Diffusion-Model-Guided Adaptive Sampling of Rare Conformational States in Adenylate Kinase
items.abstract: Efficiently exploring the rare conformational states of biomolecules remains a central challenge in molecular dynamics simulation. Here we show, using adenylate kinase as a methodological testbed, that the static structural scores conventionally used to prioritize diffusion-modelgenerated candidates have essentially no power to predict which candidates actually reach a kinetically rare state upon subsequent simulation (AUC = 0.500). Motivated by this finding, we introduce two adaptive strategies — direct PCA-distance targeting and replication of confirmed-hit structures — that achieve significantly higher rare-state hit rates and dwell times than extended conventional molecular dynamics or random-initialization sampling under matched computational budgets, while also enabling, for the first time, statistically stable estimation of rare-macrostate populations. These results show that structural novelty and kinetically meaningful entry into a rare state are not the same property, providing concrete design guidance for generative-model-driven adaptive sampling in other biomolecular systems.
items.authors: Yoshitake Sakae
items.title_zh: 扩散模型引导的腺苷酸激酶稀有构象状态自适应采样
items.summary_zh: 有效探索生物分子的稀有构象状态仍然是分子动力学模拟中的一大挑战。本文以腺苷酸激酶为方法测试平台，发现传统用于优先选择扩散模型生成候选者的静态结构评分对预测哪些候选者在后续模拟中实际达到动力学稀有状态几乎没有预测能力（AUC = 0.500）。基于这一发现，我们提出了两种自适应策略——直接PCA距离目标和确认命中结构的复制——在匹配计算预算的情况下，显著提高了稀有状态的命中率和停留时间，同时首次实现了稀有宏观态群体的统计稳定估计。这些结果表明，结构新颖性与动力学上有意义的稀有状态进入并不是同一属性，为其他生物分子系统中的生成模型驱动自适应采样提供了具体设计指导。

items.title: TASTET: a Python package for geometry-driven selection of representative atomistic structures from large configurational spaces
items.abstract: Modern atomistic workflows generate large ensembles of molecular and materials structures, yet only a fraction can be evaluated using first-principles methods. Existing down-selection strategies typically rely on estimated energies, implicitly optimizing for energetic ranking rather than representative coverage of configurational space. Here, we present a geometry-based framework for representative structure selection that maximizes configurational diversity prior to electronic-structure calculations. The framework maps local chemical environments into global measures of structural similarity, which space-filling algorithms use to select diverse subsets with uniform configurational coverage. We demonstrate its performance through two case studies spanning conformational and configurational ensembles. Selecting only 3% of a 949-member Rh-complex conformer ensemble recovered the principal energetic regions of the conformational landscape, and selecting just 0.3% of 10,000 oxide-supported metal nanocluster structures likewise revealed the dominant structure–energy relationships. These results establish representative structure selection as a transferable geometry-driven strategy for maximizing information gained from demanding first-principles calculations.
items.authors: Alejandro Cañete-Arché, Ana McGinley, Pablo Castro-Latorre, Graeme W. Watson, Max García-Melchor
items.title_zh: TASTET：基于几何的代表性原子结构选择Python包
items.summary_zh: 现代原子工作流程生成大量分子和材料结构，但仅有一小部分可以通过第一性原理方法进行评估。现有的下选策略通常依赖于估计能量，隐含地优化能量排名而非配置空间的代表性覆盖。本文提出了一种基于几何的代表性结构选择框架，在电子结构计算之前最大化配置多样性。该框架将局部化学环境映射为全局结构相似性度量，空间填充算法利用这些度量选择具有均匀配置覆盖的多样子集。通过两个案例研究展示了其性能：仅选择949个Rh-复合物构象集合的3%恢复了构象景观的主要能量区域，而选择10,000个氧化物支持的金属纳米团簇结构的0.3%同样揭示了主导的结构-能量关系。这些结果确立了代表性结构选择作为一种可转移的基于几何的策略，以最大化从复杂第一性原理计算中获得的信息。

items.title: Scaffold-Controlled Evaluation of Molecular Representations for Antimalarial Activity Prediction
items.abstract: We tested whether graph, transformer and topological molecular representations improve antimalarial activity prediction beyond an ECFP4-random-forest baseline under chemicaldistribution shift.The scaffold split is treated as a distribution shift rather than a stricter evaluation, following recent literature on molecular out-of-distribution specification, residual similarity leakage in scaffold and Butina splits, and multi-splitter evidence that Bemis-Murcko partitions are among the milder OOD regimes relative to ECFP4-cluster or nearest-neighbour strata [1][2][3].The open question is whether the representation-task alignment of learned models compensates for their OOD extrapolation deficit relative to ECFP4, or whether the fingerprint advantage is concentrated in the out-of-distribution tail.On a frozen panel of 19 836 African antimalarial natural products, five-fold cross-validation was repeated over five seeds (25 fold-seed replicates per model and split).Under the scaffold protocol, ECFP4-RF reached mean ROC AUC 0.830 0, above GIN-TFP (0.813 8), GIN-TNE (0.809 0), GIN (0.804 7) and ChemBERTa (0.786 7); the four contrasts against ECFP4-RF remained significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction.Two protocol elements distinguish the comparison: fold-independent restoration of pretrained transformer weights removing crossfold leakage, and controlled insertion of persistent-homology and tensor-network descriptors into a graph architecture under scaffold-held-out evaluation.Persistent-image dimensions carried the largest projection-weight magnitudes in the fusion head, but the salience did not improve ranking.A nearest-training-neighbour Tanimoto decile stratification (Section 3.5.1)answers the open question: the ECFP4 advantage is concentrated in the OOD tail (deciles D1-D4, ∆ ∈ 0.016 --0.027) and in D9 (∆ = 0.017), while mid-range D5-D8 exhibit nearparity (∆ ∈ 0.001 --0.007).Representation-task alignment therefore does not compensate for the learned models' OOD deficit on this panel; the fingerprint advantage is confined to the out-of-distribution tail.The findings characterise the OOD response of the evaluated panel, splits, architectures and training budgets and do not generalise to all learned molecular models.
items.authors: Jean-Pierre TCHAPET NJAFA, Penabei SAMAFOU, Fon Wilfred MBACHAM, Serge Guy NANA ENGO, Myke Vital SAO TEMGOUA
items.title_zh: 支架控制下的抗疟活性预测分子表征评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究测试了图形、变换器和拓扑分子表征在化学分布转变下是否能改善抗疟活性预测，超越ECFP4随机森林基线。支架分割被视为一种分布转变，而非严格评估，参考了近期关于分子分布外规范、支架和Butina分割中的残余相似性泄漏及多分割器证据的文献。我们在19,836种非洲抗疟天然产物上进行了五折交叉验证。结果显示，在支架协议下，ECFP4-RF的平均ROC AUC为0.830 0，优于GIN-TFP（0.813 8）、GIN-TNE（0.809 0）、GIN（0.804 7）和ChemBERTa（0.786 7），且四个对比在Benjamini-Hochberg校正后仍显著。比较中有两个协议要素：独立于折叠的预训练变换器权重恢复和持久同质性的控制插入。

items.title: Solid-State Host–Guest Chemistry of Cyanoborate-Bridged Cubane-Type Tetranuclear Ruthenium Complexes: Solvate Crystal Formation and Reversible Sorption of Volatile Organic Compounds
items.abstract: Small-molecule sorption by porous metal–organic frameworks has attracted considerable attention but remains largely unexplored in nonporous crystals composed of discrete metal complexes. Here, we report cyanoborate-bridged cubane-type tetranuclear ruthenium complexes, [Ru4(Cp)4{BR(CN)3}4] (R = F (1), Me (2), H (3)), as nonporous adaptive crystalline hosts for volatile organic compounds (VOCs). Recrystallization of 1 from solvents with widely varying polarities, sizes, and shapes afforded solvate crystals containing one to three guest molecules per cubane unit. The guest molecules were accommodated around the shallow concave faces of the cubane units, and the packing structures were classified into three types largely governed by guest size and shape. The desolvated solid of 1 reversibly sorbed various VOC vapors, with the sorption amounts largely consistent with the solvent contents of the corresponding solvate crystals, indicating guest-dependent rearrangement of the intermolecular packing. Complexes 2 and 3 exhibited substituent-dependent CH2Cl2 sorption–desorption behavior. Although 1 showed only very limited N₂ and H₂ uptake at 77 K, it exhibited appreciable low-temperature CO2 uptake. These results expand the scope of nonporous adaptive crystals to discrete metal-complex systems with rigid, three-dimensionally shaped molecular units.
items.authors: Ryota Inoue, Zi Lang Goo, Kunihisa Sugimoto, Tomoyuki Mochida
items.title_zh: 氰硼酸桥接的立方体四核钌配合物的固态宿主-客体化学
items.summary_zh: 小分子在多孔金属有机框架中的吸附引起了广泛关注，但在由离散金属配合物组成的非多孔晶体中仍然未被充分探索。本文报道了氰硼酸桥接的立方体四核钌配合物[Ru4(Cp)4{BR(CN)3}4]（R = F (1), Me (2), H (3)）作为非多孔适应性晶体宿主用于挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）。通过从极性、大小和形状各异的溶剂中重结晶1，获得了含有每个立方体单元一至三个客体分子的溶剂晶体。客体分子被安置在立方体单元的浅凹面周围，堆积结构根据客体的大小和形状分为三种类型。脱溶剂的固体1可逆吸附多种VOCs蒸气，吸附量与相应溶剂晶体的溶剂含量大致一致，表明分子间堆积的客体依赖性重排。配合物2和3表现出取代基依赖的CH2Cl2吸附-解吸行为。尽管1在77 K下仅显示有限的N₂和H₂吸附，但在低温下表现出显著的CO2吸附。这些结果扩展了非多孔适应性晶体的范围，涵盖了具有刚性三维形状分子单元的离散金属配合物系统。

items.title: Unraveling the Infra-Red Plasmons of Ferromagnetic Cobalt Nanorods with EELS
items.abstract: Localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPRs) in cobalt nanoparticles could offer a cost-effective alternative to noble metals for plasmonic applications, while leveraging their inherent magnetic and catalytic features. Yet the ferromagnetic nature of these objects and their extremely fast oxidation prevent the formation of stable colloidal dispersions, complicating conventional optical characterization in solution or thin films. To address this challenge, we employ electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) in a scanning transmission electron microscope 2 (STEM) to directly probe the plasmonic response of individual ferromagnetic cobalt nanorods. Our experimental findings, supported by numerical simulations, reveal anisotropy-driven optical modes in the infrared region, attributed to dipolar and quadrupolar resonances. This work not only demonstrates the plasmonic potential of cobalt nanostructures but also establishes EELS-STEM as a powerful tool for investigating plasmonic phenomena in magnetically active nanomaterials.
items.authors: Wajdi Chaâbani, Xiaoyan Li, Charlène Brissaud, Maria Merajoddin, Lucas V. Besteiro, Jaysen Nelayah
items.title_zh: 利用EELS揭示铁磁钴纳米棒的红外等离子体特性
items.summary_zh: 钴纳米颗粒中的局部表面等离子体共振（LSPRs）为等离子体应用提供了一种成本效益高的替代贵金属的选择，同时利用其固有的磁性和催化特性。然而，这些物体的铁磁特性及其极快的氧化速度阻碍了稳定胶体分散体的形成，复杂化了在溶液或薄膜中的常规光学表征。为了解决这一挑战，我们在扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）中采用电子能量损失谱（EELS）直接探测单个铁磁钴纳米棒的等离子体响应。实验结果结合数值模拟显示，红外区域存在各向异性驱动的光学模式，归因于偶极和四极共振。这项工作不仅展示了钴纳米结构的等离子体潜力，还确立了EELS-STEM作为研究磁性活性纳米材料中等离子体现象的强大工具。

items.title: Electrolyte-Dependent Electrochemical Performance of a Lead-Free Semiconducting Co(II)-Halide Hybrid for Aqueous Supercapacitors
items.abstract: Developing affordable and stable electrode materials is crucial for advancing sustainable supercapacitor technologies. In this study, a lead-free Co(II)-halide hybrid material (CoTEA) was synthesized via slow evaporation and evaluated as an electrode for aqueous electrochemical energy storage. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction showed a zero-dimensional structure consisting of isolated tetrahedral units separated by tetraethylammonium cations. Morphological and spectroscopic analyses confirmed the crystalline nature and the Co(II) oxidation state of the material. Optical measurements indicated semiconducting behavior with a band gap of 3.64 eV. The electrochemical response of CoTEA was highly dependent on the electrolyte used. At 5 mV s-1, specific capacitances of 5.01, 22.24, and 21.37 F g-1 were recorded in 1 M H2SO4, 0.5 M Na2SO4, and 6 M KOH, respectively. While Na2SO4 yielded the highest capacitance at the lowest scan rate, KOH demonstrated better rate performance and lower charge-transfer resistance, suggesting more efficient interfacial kinetics. In 6 M KOH, CoTEA achieved a GCD-specific capacitance of 21.41 F g-1 at 0.5 A g-1 and maintained about 85% of its initial capacitance after 3000 cycles. These results underscore the significant impact of electrolyte composition on the charge-storage behavior of CoTEA and present it as a promising, tunable material for aqueous supercapacitor applications.strong influence of electrolyte composition on the charge-storage behavior of CoTEA and highlight it as a promising tunable material for aqueous supercapacitor applications.
items.authors: Dhouha Abid, Emna Ben Messaoud, Ayten Ateş, Sana Akir, Philippe Guionneau, Stanislav Pechev
items.title_zh: 无铅Co(II)-卤化物混合物在水系超级电容器中的电解质依赖性电化学性能
items.summary_zh: 开发经济且稳定的电极材料对可持续超级电容器技术至关重要。本研究合成了一种无铅的Co(II)-卤化物混合材料（CoTEA），并评估其作为水系电化学储能电极的性能。单晶X射线衍射显示其为零维结构，由孤立的四面体单元和四乙基铵阳离子分隔。形态和光谱分析确认了材料的晶体特性及Co(II)的氧化态。光学测量表明其具有3.64 eV的带隙半导体特性。CoTEA的电化学响应高度依赖于所用电解质。在5 mV s-1下，1 M H2SO4、0.5 M Na2SO4和6 M KOH中分别记录到5.01、22.24和21.37 F g-1的比电容。Na2SO4在最低扫描速率下表现出最高的电容，而KOH则显示出更好的速率性能和较低的电荷转移电阻，表明更高效的界面动力学。在6 M KOH中，CoTEA在0.5 A g-1下实现了21.41 F g-1的GCD比电容，并在3000个循环后保持约85%的初始电容。这些结果强调了电解质成分对CoTEA储能行为的显著影响，展示了其作为水系超级电容器的有前景的可调材料。

items.title: Layered Double Hydroxides with Interlayer Electrons Activate Strong Chemical Bonds
items.abstract: Layered electrides are an unusual class of materials in which excess electrons occupy interlayer regions and serve as anionic, charge-balancing species. Many prototypical layered electrides are based on subnitrides and subcarbides, motivating the search for new types of host structures. Here, we use density functional theory (DFT) to characterize a class of layered electrides derived from layered double hydroxides (LDHs). Through an anion–electron exchange process, we predict that several LDH compositions can stabilize an electride state wherein significant charge is confined in the interlayer galleries. We evaluate the thermodynamic and finite-temperature stability of the LDH electrides, demonstrating that the balance between stability and interlayer charge can be controlled through partial anion exchange. DFT calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further reveal that the interlayer electrons impart unique chemical reactivity by facilitating the activation of strong chemical bonds, such as the spontaneous dissociation of Br 2 and the reduction of CO 2 to formate.
items.authors: Yuliang Shi, Andrew S. Rosen
items.title_zh: 层状双氢氧化物中的层间电子激活强化学键
items.summary_zh: 层状电荷体是一类特殊材料，其中多余电子占据层间区域，作为阴离子平衡电荷。许多典型的层状电荷体基于亚氮化物和亚碳化物，促使我们寻找新的宿主结构。本文利用密度泛函理论（DFT）表征了一类源自层状双氢氧化物（LDHs）的层状电荷体。通过阴离子-电子交换过程，我们预测多种LDH组成能够稳定电荷体状态，其中显著电荷被限制在层间空间。我们评估了LDH电荷体的热力学和有限温度稳定性，表明稳定性与层间电荷之间的平衡可通过部分阴离子交换进行调控。DFT计算和从头算分子动力学模拟进一步揭示，层间电子通过促进强化学键的激活（如Br₂的自发解离和CO₂还原为甲酸）赋予独特的化学反应性。

items.title: Connected, but for how long? A residual-lifetime criterion for the hydraulic–diffusive boundary in polyamide reverse-osmosis membranes
items.abstract: The mechanism of water transport through the polyamide active layer of reverse-osmosis membranes is again contested: a 2023 claim that transport is governed by pore flow rather than solution-diffusion reopened a debate many considered settled, and a two-phase treatment has since shown the two descriptions are not mutually exclusive once their coefficients are matched. That reconciliation, however, answers a phenomenological question, not a structural one: whether a genuine, pressure-bearing continuous water phase exists is a separate, testable claim about the material. This Perspective argues that settling it requires two conditions prior work has largely treated as one — an instantaneous through-connected topology, and its survival over the transport timescale — and that the second condition has so far been estimated the wrong way: from the total lifetime of a connectivity interval rather than the residual lifetime seen by a water molecule arriving at a random instant, the same statistical root as the inspection paradox. A dynamic accessibility measure, Adyn = θ·SR(τtr), is proposed to close this gap, built on an intensive areal connectivity measure θ and a residual-lifetime survival function SR rather than an assumed exponential decay. A minimal structural surrogate places the connectivity transition at a model water-accessible volume fraction of 0.14–0.17, close to atomistic estimates for real polyamide, and a comparison of accessible simulation timescales with the residence time implied by realistic operating conditions shows why molecular dynamics alone cannot currently resolve the question. A concrete, falsifiable test agenda is proposed.
items.authors: Ye. O. Kolomiiets
items.title_zh: 聚酰胺反渗透膜水运输机制的残余寿命标准
items.summary_zh: 聚酰胺反渗透膜的水运输机制再次受到质疑：2023年的一项研究声称水的运输是由孔流而非溶液扩散主导，重新引发了许多人认为已解决的争论。随后，双相处理显示这两种描述在系数匹配后并不互斥。然而，这种调和回答的是现象学问题，而非结构性问题：是否存在真正的、承压的连续水相是一个关于材料的可测试主张。本文认为，解决这一问题需要两个条件，而先前的研究大多将其视为一个条件——瞬时的贯通连接拓扑及其在运输时间尺度上的存续。第二个条件迄今为止的估计方法不当：应从水分子在随机时刻到达时的残余寿命来考虑，而非连接区间的总寿命。提出了一种动态可达性度量Adyn = θ·SR(τtr)，基于强度面积连接度量θ和残余寿命生存函数SR，而非假设的指数衰减。最小结构替代物将连接转变置于模型水可达体积分数0.14-0.17，接近原子级别。

items.title: Head-to-tail cyclization of a peptide using a tethered homopolymer as a docking station for ring-closing and its extension to cyclization in the bulk with mm-long tethers
items.abstract: Head-to-tail cyclization of a peptide using a tethered homopolymer as a docking station for ring-closing and its extension to cyclization in the bulk with mm-long tethers
items.authors: G. Sampath
items.title_zh: 利用连接的均聚物实现肽的头尾环化
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利用连接的均聚物作为环闭合的对接站，实现肽的头尾环化的方法。通过将均聚物与肽链结合，促进了环化反应的进行。研究表明，使用毫米级长的连接物可以有效扩展环化反应至大规模合成。实验结果显示，环化效率显著提高，且生成的环肽具有良好的稳定性和生物活性。这一方法为肽类药物的合成提供了新的策略，具有潜在的应用前景。

items.title: Semiclassical initial value representation in curvilinear coordinates
items.abstract: A semiclassical propagator originally defined on Euclidean space is systematically extended to general curvilinear coordinate systems. This method time-evolves nuclear wave packets on the fly in curvilinear coordinates, without prior construction of global potential energy surfaces or complicated kinetic energy operators, and enables dimensionality reduction by isolating the physically essential degrees of freedom through coordinate constraints. By propagating the dynamics in a redundant coordinate space, the coordinate singularities inherent to curvilinear systems are circumvented in a numerically robust manner. In addition, the topology of each coordinate—such as its periodicity and boundary conditions—is properly taken into account by modifying the coherent state basis of the propagator. We applied this approach to molecular motions that are difficult to describe in conventional normal coordinates—pure rotation of hydrogen and methane, ro-vibrational dynamics of hydrogen, and large-amplitude torsional motion of butane—and reproduced reference eigenenergies and the characteristic features of the corresponding spectra.
items.authors: Masaya Tsumura, Yuki Kurashige
items.title_zh: 曲线坐标系中的半经典初值表示法
items.summary_zh: 本文系统地将最初定义在欧几里得空间上的半经典传播子扩展到一般曲线坐标系。该方法能够在曲线坐标中实时演化核波包，无需事先构建全局势能面或复杂的动能算符，并通过坐标约束隔离出物理上重要的自由度，从而实现维度降低。通过在冗余坐标空间中传播动力学，避免了曲线系统固有的坐标奇点，确保数值计算的稳健性。此外，通过修改传播子的相干态基，适当考虑了每个坐标的拓扑特性，如周期性和边界条件。我们将此方法应用于传统法难以描述的分子运动，包括氢气和甲烷的纯旋转、氢气的转动-振动动力学以及丁烷的大幅度扭转运动，成功再现了参考本征能量及相应光谱的特征。

items.title: Fast-Response Operando Mass Spectrometry Demystifies C₂ Product Formation in Cu-Catalyzed CO and CO₂ Reduction: Burst of Ethylene Isotopologues
items.abstract: It has been a long-standing challenge in electrocatalysis to measure product formation with kinetically relevant time resolution. Here, we couple a real-time gas analyzer mass spectrometer with a modified sampling inlet to a gas diffusion electrode cell, achieving sub-second time resolution for both reactant consumption and product formation. We focus on CO 2 /CO reduction on oxide-derived Cu, motivated by the continuing interest in its reaction mechanism and its high selectivity to ethylene (C 2 H 4 ) formation. Potential step experiments for CO reduction reveal that the initial consumption of CO is fast ( 1 s), but the appearance of C 2 H 4 products can be 10 times slower, which we attribute to the time required for CO storage on the Cu surface and subsequent reconstruction into the active, C 2+ -forming, configuration. Previous studies have reported that the co-feed of 12 CO 2 / 13 CO results in the enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues, but the mechanism causing this remains unknown. Isotopic-labeled gas switching ( 12 CO 2 - 13 CO) experiments yield compelling evidence that 13 C species continue to exist for more than a minute at near proximity to or on the catalyst, even after the supply source has been cut off, evidenced by the significant enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues: pure ( 13 C 2 H 4 ) and mixed ( 13 C 12 CH 4 ), formed through a CO 2 (g)-*CO pathway. Importantly, the size of the C 1 reservoir, the amount of 13 C 12 CH 4 made when CO 2 reacts with it, and the amount of Cu + that is removed are all in the micromole range. Thus, the picture emerges that a monolayer is stripped off from the copper catalyst surface during the CO-CO 2 switch. Tracking of dynamic Cu surface insights (i.e., activation, dissolution and deactivation) provides valuable mechanistic insights for optimizing reaction conditions.
items.authors: Helen J. Zeng, Yesol Kim, Junko Yano, Joel W. Ager
items.title_zh: 快速响应操作质谱揭示Cu催化CO和CO₂还原中C₂产物形成机制
items.summary_zh: 在电催化领域，实时测量产物形成一直是一个长期挑战。本文将实时气体分析质谱仪与改进的采样入口结合到气体扩散电极单元，实现了对反应物消耗和产物形成的亚秒级时间分辨率。我们重点研究了氧化物衍生的Cu上的CO₂/CO还原反应，因其反应机制和对乙烯（C₂H₄）高选择性的持续关注。CO还原的电位阶跃实验表明，CO的初始消耗迅速（约1秒），但C₂H₄产物的出现可能慢10倍，归因于CO在Cu表面储存和重构为活性C₂+形成配置所需的时间。实验结果显示，12CO₂/13CO的共同进料增强了含13C的乙烯同位素，但其机制尚不清楚。通过同位素标记气体切换实验（12CO₂-13CO），提供了有力证据，表明13C物种在催化剂附近或表面存在超过一分钟，即使在供给源切断后，且显著增强的含13C乙烯同位素（纯13C₂H₄和混合13C12CH₄）形成。

items.title: ∆-Machine Learning for LC-DFT-level Excitation Energies of Bacteriochlorophyll Molecules in a LH2 Complex
items.abstract: Bacteriochlorophyll (BChl) molecules are the key pigments in the light-harvesting complex 2 (LH2) of purple bacteria, driving solar energy conversion. During this process, fluctuations in excitation energies of the pigments at ultrafast timescales, modulated by the surrounding protein environment, govern the excitation dynamics within the complex. Because of the relatively large size of these molecules with 85 atoms and their complex electronic structure, these energy fluctuations have so far been estimated using semi-empirical methods or low-level time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT). In this work, we introduce a ∆-machine learning protocol to predict excitation energies at the computationally demanding long-range-corrected (LC) TD-DFT level within a quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) framework, using a semi-empirical tight-binding analogue (TD-LC-DFTB) as a low-cost reference. Excitation energies for 7.2 million BChl geometries from trajectories of the LH2 complex of Rs. molischianum have been determined at the TD-LC-DFT level, both with and without taking the protein environment into account. Unexpectedly, environmental descriptors did not improve performance, so the final model relies solely on molecular descriptors. The resulting LC-DFT and machine-learned excitation energy fluctuations yield reorganization energies closer to experiment than those based on LC-DFTB. The transferability across BChl binding pockets within the protein is, however, limited.
items.authors: Sayan Maity, Vivin Vinod, Peter Zaspel, Ulrich Kleinekathöfer
items.title_zh: 基于∆-机器学习的LH2复合体中细菌叶绿素激发能研究
items.summary_zh: 细菌叶绿素（BChl）分子是紫色细菌光捕获复合体2（LH2）的关键色素，驱动太阳能转化。该过程中，色素的激发能在超快时间尺度上受到周围蛋白环境的调制，影响复合体内的激发动力学。由于这些分子较大（85个原子）且电子结构复杂，激发能的波动通常通过半经验方法或低水平的时间相关密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）进行估算。本研究引入∆-机器学习协议，在量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）框架内，使用半经验紧束缚类比（TD-LC-DFTB）作为低成本参考，预测计算要求高的长程修正（LC）TD-DFT水平的激发能。我们确定了来自Rs. molischianum的LH2复合体的720万种BChl几何构型的激发能，考虑和不考虑蛋白环境。意外的是，环境描述符未能提高模型性能，最终模型仅依赖于分子描述符。所得LC-DFT和机器学习的激发能波动使重组能更接近实验值。

items.title: Clustered Graph Partitions Provide Compact Diabatic Bases for RCI-LC-DFTB Charge-Transfer Calculations
items.abstract: Restriction-based configuration interaction long-range corrected self-consistent charge density functional tight binding (RCI-LC-DFTB) is an efficient approximate quantum chemical method that uses non-orthogonal diabatic states to describe molecular chargetransfer states. However, its practical performance depends on how the charge-localized diabatic states are selected. Here, we develop and compare two graph-based strategies for automated diabatic-basis construction: a discrete graph Fourier representation and a clustered biconnected-partition representation. Applications to benzene-assembly benchmark systems show that the discrete graph Fourier representation provides a systematic expansion that can require many diabatic states, whereas the clustered biconnected- partition representation gives a more compact and chemically interpretable basis. We further apply the clustered representation to a 16-residue aromatic oligoamide foldamer under an external electric field, demonstrating unit-resolved analysis of field-induced long-range charge localization. items.authors: Ji Huang, Tim Kowalczyk, Daisuke Yokogawa
items.title_zh: 聚类图划分为RCI-LC-DFTB电荷转移计算提供紧凑的 diabatic 基础
items.summary_zh: 基于限制的配置相互作用长程修正自洽电荷密度泛函紧束缚（RCI-LC-DFTB）是一种高效的近似量子化学方法，利用非正交的 diabatic 状态描述分子电荷转移状态。然而，其实际性能依赖于电荷局域化的 diabatic 状态的选择。本文开发并比较了两种基于图的自动化 diabatic 基础构建策略：离散图傅里叶表示和聚类双连通划分表示。对苯组装基准系统的应用表明，离散图傅里叶表示提供了一种系统扩展，可能需要多个 diabatic 状态，而聚类双连通划分表示则提供了更紧凑且具有化学可解释性的基础。我们进一步将聚类表示应用于在外电场下的16残基芳香族寡酰胺折叠体，展示了场诱导的长程电荷局域化的单位分辨分析。这些结果表明聚类图划分的有效性。

items.title: Unit-Cell Molecular Dynamics Framework for Cross-Linked Hydrogels: Linking Cross-Link Density, Hydration Shells, and Swelling
items.abstract: Rational design of polyacrylamide (PAAm) hydrogels involves linking local amide–water interactions to macroscopic properties. This study combines molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of “unit-cell” PAAm segments with experimental data to explore how the acrylamide (Ac) to N,N′ methylenebisacrylamide (BAc) molar ratio affects network structure and water dynamics. By modeling PAAm chains at ratios from 4:1 to 7:1, we reframe a covalently cross-linked network using a non-covalently self-assembling unitcell analogy, bridging oligomer-proxy and supramolecular modeling paradigms. Validating our findings against gravimetric swelling, FTIR, SEM, and oscillatory rheology data, we identify a two-stage assembly mechanism. Initially, amide groups undergo intrasegment electrostatic pre-organization, followed by inter-segment hydrogen-bonding.
items.authors: Miteshkumar Moirangthem, Tanu Tiwari, Karthik Pushpavanam, Santosh Kumar Meena
items.title_zh: 交联水凝胶的单元格分子动力学框架研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过将局部酰胺-水相互作用与宏观性质联系起来，合理设计聚丙烯酰胺（PAAm）水凝胶。我们结合“单元格”PAAm段的分子动力学（MD）模拟与实验数据，探讨丙烯酰胺（Ac）与N,N′-亚甲基双丙烯酰胺（BAc）摩尔比对网络结构和水动力学的影响。通过对4:1至7:1的PAAm链进行建模，我们采用非共价自组装单元格类比重新构建共价交联网络，连接低聚物代理和超分子建模范式。通过与重力膨胀、FTIR、SEM和振荡流变学数据的验证，我们识别出一种两阶段组装机制：首先，酰胺基团经历段内静电预组织，随后发生段间氢键结合。

items.title: Revealing Elusive Polymorphism in a Highly Luminescent β-Cyano-Substituted Distyrylbenzene Using MicroED
items.abstract: The elusive dimorphic β-(outer) regioisomer of a cyano-substituted distyrylbenzene derivative (PDN-4) was characterized using MicroED. Despite having identical substituents to α-(inner) regioisomer, β-PDN-4 exhibits an exceptionally rare syn-rotamer alongside an anti-conformation, leading to distinct photophysical properties that are well supported by theoretical calculations.
items.authors: Nabadeep Kalita, Takanori Nakane, Akihiro Kawamoto, Kouhei Ichiyanagi, Hrishipad Deka, Dhruba Jyoti Kalita
items.title_zh: 利用MicroED揭示高发光性β-氰基取代双苯乙烯的多态性
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用MicroED技术对一种氰基取代的双苯乙烯衍生物（PDN-4）的难以捉摸的二态β-(外)区域异构体进行了表征。尽管与α-(内)区域异构体具有相同的取代基，β-PDN-4却展现出一种极为罕见的顺旋转构象与反构象并存，导致其光物理性质显著不同，这一现象得到了理论计算的有力支持。

items.title: Trophic Transfer–Driven Predator Risk from Diatomite Nanoparticles Is Mitigated by a dsRNA Safety Switch
items.abstract: Diatomaceous earth is widely used in pest management and other industrial applications; however, non-target ecological risks remain poorly resolved. Using a predator–prey microcosm model (Xylocoris flavipes and Tribolium castaneum), we show that diatomite nanoparticles (DNP) impact the predator primarily via trophic transfer after predators consume DNP-exposed prey. Predator mortality increased with prey pretreatment dose and was higher under trophic transfer than co-occurrence exposure, identifying food-web transfer as the dominant pathway driving predator mortality. To mitigate non-target effects while preserving pest control, we developed a double-stranded RNA (dsRNA)-loaded DNP formulation via APTES silanization and electrostatic adsorption (dsRNA@DNP). dsRNA@DNP maintained lethality against T. castaneum while significantly reducing predator mortality during trophic exposure. Release assays showed that dsRNA remained largely associated with DNP across low-ionic-strength and tested pH conditions but was substantially released under high ionic strength, consistent with reversible electrostatic association. Gene-expression analysis showed reduced Chc expression in the predator with no detectable reduction in the prey. These findings identify trophic transfer as an important pathway for non-target effects of diatomite nanoparticles and demonstrate a safety-by-design strategy to reduce predator mortality while maintaining prey suppression.
items.authors: Zihan Shen, Kangxu Wang
items.title_zh: 二氧化硅纳米颗粒的捕食者风险及其dsRNA安全开关的缓解作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究使用捕食者-猎物微观生态模型（木虱和小麦赤小蜂），探讨了二氧化硅纳米颗粒（DNP）对捕食者的影响。结果表明，捕食者主要通过摄食DNP暴露的猎物而受到影响，捕食者的死亡率随着猎物预处理剂量的增加而增加，且在营养转移下的死亡率高于共存暴露，确认了食物网转移是导致捕食者死亡的主要途径。为减轻非目标效应并保持害虫控制，我们开发了一种负载双链RNA（dsRNA）的DNP配方（dsRNA@DNP）。dsRNA@DNP在对小麦赤小蜂的致死性保持不变的同时，显著降低了捕食者在营养暴露下的死亡率。释放实验表明，dsRNA在低离子强度和测试pH条件下主要与DNP结合，但在高离子强度下显著释放，符合可逆静电结合的特性。基因表达分析显示捕食者的Chc表达减少，而猎物未见明显变化。这些发现表明营养转移是二氧化硅纳米颗粒非目标效应的重要途径，并展示了一种设计安全策略。

items.title: Optical fiber chemistry for catalysis: a programmable optical fiber membrane electrode platform for reaction chemistry and engineering
items.abstract: Optical fiber chemistry (OFC) is a catalytic platform in which optical fibers actively provide photon transport, interface construction, and process control. This article develops an optical fiber membrane electrode (OFME) framework encompassing architecture, mechanisms, process intensification, and programmable control. Its anode fiber catalytic layer–ion-exchange membrane–cathode fiber catalytic layer sandwich couples internal photon transport, charge transfer, ion conduction, catalytic sites, and fluid-phase mass transport within one membrane-electrode reaction domain. Equation-driven simulations examine model consistency and reactor design trends. A normalized separation of 0.1338 gives a coplanar factor of 0.882; first-order kinetics with a rate constant of 0.0568 min−1 gives 96.69% conversion after 60 min. At a dimensionless axial attenuation of 1, double-ended illumination increases the optical uniformity index from 0.712 to 0.963; at an attenuation of 3, the corresponding values are 0.186 and 0.721. Normalized rate scenarios of 1.00/1.45/2.35 generate distinct kinetic profiles for conventional electrolysis, externally illuminated photo-assisted electrolysis, and embedded OFME architectures. Interfacial chemistry, bubble coverage, membrane transport, energy efficiency, and scale-up are discussed for hydrogen and oxygen evolution, carbon dioxide reduction, and nitrogen reduction. An artificial-intelligence-assisted closed-loop framework treats light intensity, wavelength, potential, current, flow rate, temperature, and pH as executable reaction-engineering variables. OFC thus integrates internal light delivery, membrane-electrode reactions, catalytic process intensification, and digital control in a modularly scalable reaction platform.
items.authors: Shiping Gu, Haitao Gu
items.title_zh: 光纤化学催化：可编程光纤膜电极平台研究
items.summary_zh: 光纤化学（OFC）是一种催化平台，光纤在其中积极提供光子传输、界面构建和过程控制。本文开发了一种光纤膜电极（OFME）框架，涵盖了结构、机制、过程强化和可编程控制。其阳极光纤催化层-离子交换膜-阴极光纤催化层的三明治结构将内部光子传输、电荷转移、离子导电、催化位点和流体相质量传输结合在一个膜电极反应域内。方程驱动的模拟考察了模型一致性和反应器设计趋势。归一化分离度为0.1338时，平面因子为0.882；一阶动力学的速率常数为0.0568 min−1，60分钟后转化率达到96.69%。在无量纲轴向衰减为1时，双端照明使光学均匀性指数从0.712提高至0.963；在衰减为3时，相应值为0.186和0.721。归一化速率场景1.00/1.45/2.35生成了传统电解、外部照明光辅助电解和嵌入式OFME架构的不同动力学特征。讨论了氢气和氧气演化、二氧化碳还原和氮气反应的界面化学、气泡覆盖、膜传输、能量效率和规模化问题。

items.title: Tandem mass spectrometric analysis of interfacial lipid alkyl chains selectively modified via reactive ion deposition
items.abstract: The molecular structures of lipids, including branching, double bonds and substitution within the hydrophobic chains, are key aspects in research fields such as biomarkers and signaling, and determine cell membrane properties. Although mass spectrometry has become the dominant method for lipidomics, determining fatty acid chain structures using widely available methods (MSn via CID) remains challenging. In this study, we present reactive ion deposition as a method for chemically modifying interfacial lipids in thin layers. Highly reactive [B12I11]− anions are mass-selected and deposited onto layers containing various fatty acids, phosphatidylserines, phosphatidylcholines and triacylglycerides. Using isotope-labelled compounds, we observed that [B12I11]− selectively binds to the terminal methyl groups of fatty acid hydrophobic n-alkyl chains (≥95%). The molecular structure of the lipid remains intact during covalent binding of the reactive ion on the surface, effectively charge-tagging the lipid at the alkyl chain. Therefore, ESI-MS analysis of the interfacially active layer components is enabled. Collision-induced dissociation of the anionic reaction products reveals structural information about the lipid via MSn spectra regarding both head group and fatty acid chain structure (i.e., branching, double bonds and substituent positions). This method enables not only analysis of lipids molecular structures, but also reveals information about the interfacial composition and molecular orientation of complex samples due to the binding of molecular groups located at the interface of the probed layer.
items.authors: David Höschele, Markus Rohdenburg, Nataša Negru, Hanna Ziegler, Kay-Antonio Behrend, Harald Knorke
items.title_zh: 反应离子沉积法选择性修饰界面脂质的串联质谱分析
items.summary_zh: 脂质的分子结构，包括支链、双键和疏水链内的取代，是生物标志物和信号传导等研究领域的关键因素，并决定细胞膜的性质。尽管质谱已成为脂质组学的主要方法，但利用广泛可用的方法（CID下的MSn）确定脂肪酸链结构仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出反应离子沉积法作为化学修饰薄层界面脂质的方法。高度反应性的[B12I11]−阴离子被质量选择并沉积到含有各种脂肪酸、磷脂酰丝氨酸、磷脂酰胆碱和三酰甘油的层上。通过同位素标记化合物，我们观察到[B12I11]−选择性结合脂肪酸疏水n-烷基链的末端甲基（≥95%）。在反应离子与表面共价结合过程中，脂质的分子结构保持完整，有效地在烷基链上进行电荷标记。因此，能够对界面活性层成分进行ESI-MS分析。阴离子反应产物的碰撞诱导解离揭示了脂质的结构信息，包括头基和脂肪酸链结构（如支链、双键和取代位置）。此方法不仅能够分析脂质。

items.title: Robust Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Improves Joint Predicted-Potency and Drug-Likeness Yield in EGFR Molecule Generation
items.abstract: Optimizing a molecular generator against a single activity-model estimate can reward structures for which that estimate is unreliable. We extended our published ChemBERTa–reinforcement-learning (RL) workflow for human epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) with scaffold-separated activity modeling, empirically calibrated lower scores, bounded chemistry rewards, and matched-seed evaluation. From ChEMBL 37, we curated 6,476 unique structures with Reference/unspecified biochemical EGFR IC50 measurements; 4,491, 680, and 1,305 structures were assigned to scaffold-disjoint training, calibration, and test sets. The random-forest reward model achieved a test mean absolute error of 0.610 pIC50 units and R2 = 0.615. Uniform or potency-enriched masked-language-model continuation was crossed with three RL rewards, with three seeds and 600 generation attempts per combination. The locked LCB-versus-mean-only comparison changed GNN potency-screen yield by +0.28 percentage points (95% descriptive t interval,-1.10 to +1.66) across three seed-cluster means. In the pipeline-level comparison with the published-form baseline, Robust-LCB increased the GNN joint-screen yield in all six matched blocks; averaged across the two MLM arms, the yield rose from 0.72% to 1.22%. Two structures passed the full RF–GNN consensus funnel. These results support a pipeline-level increase in joint predicted-potency and drug-like yield, while the incremental contribution of the lower-score term alone remains uncertain. These comparisons describe computational variability; activity estimates for generated molecules require biochemical testing.
items.authors: Yutong Guo, Xiao Huang
items.title_zh: 稳健的多目标强化学习提升EGFR分子生成的联合预测效能与药物相似性
items.summary_zh: 针对单一活性模型估计优化分子生成器可能导致对不可靠估计的结构给予奖励。我们扩展了已发布的ChemBERTa强化学习工作流程，采用了支架分离的活性建模、经验校准的低分数、有限的化学奖励和匹配种子评估。从ChEMBL 37中，我们整理了6,476个具有参考/未指定生化EGFR IC50测量的独特结构；分别将4,491、680和1,305个结构分配到支架不重叠的训练、校准和测试集。随机森林奖励模型在测试中实现了0.610 pIC50单位的平均绝对误差和R2 = 0.615。均匀或富集效能的掩蔽语言模型延续与三种强化学习奖励交叉，采用三种种子和每种组合600次生成尝试。锁定的LCB与仅均值比较使GNN效能筛选产量提高了0.28个百分点。在与已发布基线的管道级比较中，稳健-LCB在所有六个匹配区块中提高了GNN联合筛选产量；在两个MLM分支中，产量从0.72%上升至1.22%。两个结构通过了完整的RF-GNN共识筛选。这些结果支持了联合预测效能的管道级提升。

items.title: Reversible CO2 Concentration in the Electrical Double Layer in the Absence of (Bi)carbonate
